pois.label: 定位：为什么是红外 FEL，为什么在 30 m 岩下
pois.label_en: Siting: why an infrared FEL, and why under 30 m of rock
pois.detail: 城市的第一台大科学装置，选型不是「能造多大造多大」，而是「城里放得下、用户就在楼下、账算得清」。X 射线 FEL 在地球上都是国家实验室级别：1.5 Å 要 13.6 GeV，常温铜机 8 MV/m 就是 1.7 km 直线段；换超导则需要吨级液氦——而火星大气氦只有 ppm 量级。于是本机走 FELIX/CLIO 血统：20–50 MeV 常温铜直线加速器 + 可调间隙波荡器 + 光学谐振腔，波长 10–150 µm 连续可调（发布口径两次被自家账修小：5–150 → 6.5–150（账 19，5 µm 真束流不点火）→ 10–150（账 20，50 MeV 束能上沿 RF 买不起）），整机主线 29.5 m，放进 56×20×12 m 的地下洞室。30 m 岩是免费的屏蔽、恒温热沉与「无昼夜」的边界条件。
pois.detail_en: The colony's first large science facility. Selection was not about building the biggest machine but the one that fits, whose users live downstairs, and whose ledgers close. An X-ray FEL is national-lab scale even on Earth: 1.5 A needs 13.6 GeV, i.e. 1.7 km of normal-conducting linac at 8 MV/m; the superconducting route needs tonnes of liquid helium, and Mars has helium only at the ppm level. So this machine follows the FELIX/CLIO lineage: a 20-50 MeV room-temperature copper linac, a variable-gap undulator and an optical cavity, continuously tunable from 10 to 150 um (the published band was twice revised down by the facility's own ledgers: 5-150 to 6.5-150 by ledger 19, whose true beam kills the 5 um end, then to 10-150 by ledger 20, which found the RF budget cannot buy the 50 MeV top energy), with a 29.5 m main line inside a 56x20x12 m rock cavern. The 30 m of overburden is free shielding, a constant-temperature heat sink and a boundary condition with no diurnal term.

specs.电子能量: 20–37 MeV（账 21 HFSS 定版：分路阻抗 35.3 MΩ/m 数值背书 + 行波馈电账；装机极限 40.6），1.0 GHz 常温铜直线加速器
specs.谱系网补洞: 14 µm – 1.6 mm 原本全空；三次谐波盖 3.33–50 µm，残洞 1.7–3.33 µm在账 20 修订后留为真空档
specs.低温设备: 零。全站无氦、无液氮、无冷箱
specs.地下三条理由: 屏蔽（账5）· 无昼夜（账8）· 波长稳定度（账13，取代原「腔长」）

specs_en.Wavelength: 10-150 um continuously tunable (machine envelope 4.9-386 um; 5-150 to 6.5-150 by ledger 19, to 10-150 by ledger 20)
specs_en.Beam energy: 20-37 MeV (ledger 21: HFSS-backed 35.3 MOhm/m shunt impedance plus the traveling-wave feed account; 40.6 at the installed limit), 1.0 GHz room-temperature copper linac
specs_en.Spectral gap filled: 14 um - 1.6 mm was empty; the coherent third harmonic covers 3.33-50 um, leaving 1.7-3.33 um open after the ledger-20 revision
specs_en.Cavern: 56 x 20 x 12 m, 30 m underground; 29.5 m machine line
specs_en.Cryogenics: None. No helium, no LN2, no cold box anywhere on site
specs_en.Three reasons to go underground: Shielding (L5), no diurnal cycle (L8), wavelength stability (L13, replacing the original cavity-length argument)

sim: 账 1 闸门（已知答案）：把 FELIX 参数（λu = 65 mm）代入 λ = λu/(2γ²)(1+K²/2)，四个端点全部落回其公布的 FEL-1 25–150 µm / FEL-2 3–45 µm 区间内（15 MeV/K=2.40 → 146 µm；50 MeV/K=0.95 → 4.9 µm）→ PASS。
账 8 氦账：LCLS-II 级 2 K 冷箱总存量 10–12 t 氦；火星大气按 4 ppm 计，氦密度 5.6 µg/m³，提 1 t 需处理 1.8e11 m³ 大气（100 m³/s 要跑 57 年）。→ 超导路线否决，不是保守是算过。
账 8 热账：30 m 深处日温波衰减 e^-326、年波 e^-12.6 → 岩温恒为年平均 210.4 K。「夜间 −80 °C 帮助散热」在这个深度**不成立**；30 m 岩给的是恒温热沉与外部热强迫为零。
账 4 电网账：全站平均 74 kW = 全城 176 MWe 的 0.042%；年耗 249 MWh/火星年。

第二轮深挖后，「为什么在 30 m 岩下」有了**三条彼此独立**的理由，而且第一轮给的那条被换掉了：①**屏蔽**（账 5：30 m 玄武岩 = 82 个十倍层，对地表贡献在任何仪器上都不存在）；②**无昼夜**（账 8：日温波衰减 e⁻³²⁶，外部热强迫为零）；③**稳定性**（账 13：波荡器 NdFeB 磁体温度系数 0.144 %/K，洞室 ±0.1 K 给 0.014% 波长稳定度 = 谱宽的 3%，而地面 ±10 K 会给 1.44% = 谱宽的 288%）。**第一轮把理由挂在「腔长热漂移」上，账 9 把腔长公差放松了两个量级，那条已经不成立**——第③条取代它，而且更干净：它不依赖任何机械方案，只依赖磁体本身的材料常数。

账 19（第七轮）：发布波段 5–150 → 6.5–150 µm。5 µm 在真束流（20 A/0.02%）下不点火：一维增益 0.115、建立需 >1000 圈 ≫ 宏脉冲 500 圈；三维实测单圈增益 ≈0、饱和 0 µJ。抢救检查换高流工作点（36 A/σδ 0.53%）——σ_p 飙到 2.18，能散折减把增益打到 0.090 反而更低，两个工作点都死。恢复 5 µm 是设施升级项：波荡器 40→60+ 周期（加长 1.3 m）或注入链降发射度。

账 20（第八轮）：发布波段二修 6.5–150 → 10–150 µm，这次死因不在 FEL 物理在 RF 预算——账 4 的 13.6 MW 设计包络（2×8 MW klystron）在 0.77 相位效率下只买得起 38.1 MeV（装机极限零裕量 41.8），而 6.5 µm 边界要 50 MeV（需 22.3 MW = 装机 139%）。38 MeV 下 6.5 µm 的 K 掉到 0.47、增益 −0.003。这是「账 4 只算功率总账、账 19 只按共振选束能」的跨账漏洞——与账 15 抓的「1 GHz 模式电流没人查」同款，第二次出现。升级路径也算了：2×10 MW 只到 47 MeV 仍不够，要 2×12 MW 才够 50。

账 35（第十九轮）热网与电网清账：**精密水温规格从物理落地**——铜失谐 17 kHz/K（对 SLAC S 波段文献校准 1.2%）→ 行波相位滑移 26°/K → 开环要 ±16 mK 不可行 → **±0.1 K 精密水 + LLRF 慢环钉均值，只剩二阶散布 9e-5、吃预算 17%**——LLRF 从奢侈品变结构性前提（与账 13/29 同链条）；RF 脉冲加热 0.53 K/脉冲不入账。三回路定版（精密 2.9 kW/DN40 · 工艺 36 kW/ΔT5K · 风冷 35 kW），泵功 1.4 kW 对上账 4 撬块 6 kW。**十年岩温瞬态成账（挂账清偿）**：定温洞室（等效球 R=18 m、ΔT=78 K）向无限岩体 Q(t)=Q∞(1+R/√παt)——10 年 57.5 kW → 稳态 35.3 kW，外排需求百年爬坡到 38.7 kW，**45 kW 外排设计世纪级成立（裕度 1.16×）**，早年 HVAC 可低配；热前锋 32 m 与账 8 的 35 m 回归一致。岩沉不是会耗尽的电池，是 1/√t 的弹簧。四闸全绿（球面瞬态 5 时刻 <3%）。#15 → L2。
sim_en: Ledger 1 gate (known answer): feeding FELIX parameters (65 mm period) into lambda = lambda_u/(2 gamma^2)(1+K^2/2) reproduces all four published endpoints of FEL-1 (25-150 um) and FEL-2 (3-45 um): 15 MeV / K=2.40 gives 146 um, 50 MeV / K=0.95 gives 4.9 um. PASS.

Ledger 8, helium: an LCLS-II class 2 K plant holds 10-12 t of helium. At an assumed 4 ppm Martian abundance the atmosphere carries 5.6 ug/m3, so one tonne means processing 1.8e11 m3 of air - 57 years at 100 m3/s. The superconducting route is rejected by arithmetic, not by caution.

Ledger 8, thermal: at 30 m the diurnal thermal wave is attenuated by e^-326 and the annual wave by e^-12.6, so the rock sits at the annual mean, 210.4 K. 'The -80 C night helps cooling' is simply false at this depth; what the rock gives is a constant sink and a zero external forcing term.
Ledger 4, grid: 74 kW site average = 0.042% of the colony's 176 MWe; 249 MWh per Mars year.

After the second round of digging, there are three mutually independent reasons for putting this machine 30 m underground - and the one given in the first round has been replaced. First, shielding: ledger 5 shows 30 m of basalt is 82 tenth-value layers, so the surface contribution does not exist on any instrument. Second, no diurnal cycle: ledger 8 shows the daily thermal wave is attenuated by e^-326, leaving zero external thermal forcing. Third, stability: ledger 13 shows the undulator's NdFeB temperature coefficient of 0.144 %/K turns the cavern's +/-0.1 K into 0.014% wavelength stability, three percent of the linewidth, whereas +/-10 K on the surface would give 1.44%, or 288%. The first round hung the argument on cavity-length thermal drift; ledger 9 loosened that tolerance by two orders of magnitude, so that reason no longer holds. The third reason replaces it and is cleaner: it depends on no mechanical scheme, only on a material constant of the magnets.

Ledger 19 (round 7): published band revised from 5-150 to 6.5-150 um. At 5 um the true beam (20 A / 0.02%) does not lase: 1D gain 0.115 needs >1000 round trips to build up versus the 500 available in a macropulse, and the 3D code measures zero single-pass gain and zero saturated output. The rescue check - switching to the high-current working point (36 A / 0.53% spread) - makes it worse (gain 0.090): the energy-spread penalty eats more than the current buys. Both working points are dead, so recovering 5 um is a facility upgrade (60+ undulator periods, +1.3 m, or a brighter injector), not a tuning job.

Ledger 20 (round 8): second band revision, 6.5-150 to 10-150 um - and this time the killer is not FEL physics but the RF budget. Ledger 4's 13.6 MW design envelope (2x8 MW klystrons) buys only 38.1 MeV at the measured 0.77 phase efficiency (41.8 MeV at the installed limit with zero margin), while the 6.5 um boundary needs 50 MeV, i.e. 22.3 MW = 139% of installed power. At 38 MeV the undulator K at 6.5 um collapses to 0.47 and the gain to -0.003. This is the same class of cross-ledger hole ledger 15 caught once before ('nobody checked the 1 GHz mode current'): ledger 4 only audited total RF power, ledger 19 only picked beam energies from the resonance formula. The upgrade path is also priced: 2x10 MW reaches only 47 MeV; 50 MeV takes 2x12 MW tubes.

Ledger 35 (round 19) settles thermal and grid: **the precision-water spec now derives from physics** - copper detuning 17 kHz/K (calibrated 1.2% against the SLAC S-band literature value) -> traveling-wave phase slip 26 deg/K -> open loop would need +/-16 mK (infeasible) -> **+/-0.1 K precision water + the LLRF slow loop pinning the mean leaves only the second-order spread, 9e-5, 17% of budget** - LLRF goes from luxury to structural precondition (same chain as ledgers 13/29); RF pulse heating 0.53 K/pulse stays off the books. Three cooling loops frozen (precision 2.9 kW/DN40, technical 36 kW/dT 5K, air 35 kW), pump power 1.4 kW consistent with ledger 4's 6 kW skid. **The ten-year rock-temperature transient is now a ledger (open debt repaid)**: the cavern (equivalent sphere R=18 m, dT=78 K) conducts into infinite rock as Q(t)=Qinf(1+R/sqrt(pi a t)) - 57.5 kW at 10 years decaying to 35.3 kW steady, so the export requirement climbs over a century to 38.7 kW and **the 45 kW export design holds on a century scale (margin 1.16x)**, with early-years HVAC downsizable; the 32 m thermal front matches ledger 8's 35 m. The rock sink is not a battery that drains but a 1/sqrt(t) spring. All four gates green (spherical transient <3% at 5 epochs). Subsystem #15 -> L2.
physics: FEL 共振：电子在波荡器里横向摆动，只有当光波每个周期恰好超前电子一个波长时能量交换才相干累加 —— 这就给出 λ = λu/(2γ²)(1+K²/2)。波长由 γ² 决定，所以「短波贵」是二次方的贵。
选红外不是降级而是换赛道：同一条相干性判据 ε ≤ λ/4π 在 100 µm 上给出 20 倍富余，在 1.5 Å 上给出不足 1 倍（见控制室卡与波荡器卡）。
physics_en: FEL resonance: the electron wiggles transversely in the undulator, and energy exchange only adds coherently when the light slips ahead by exactly one wavelength per period. That yields lambda = lambda_u/(2 gamma^2)(1+K^2/2). Wavelength scales as 1/gamma^2, so short wavelengths are expensive quadratically.
Choosing the infrared is not a downgrade but a different track: the same coherence criterion, emittance <= lambda/4pi, leaves a factor of 20 of headroom at 100 um and less than unity at 1.5 A.

pois.label: 热阴极电子枪与注入器
pois.detail: 100 kV 直流高压台上的三极管热阴极枪，栅极按 1.0 GHz（或 25 MHz 分频）调制发射，出来的束团先经 250 MHz 次谐波聚束腔与聚束段压到 ~10 ps，再由下游磁压缩 chicane 压到 4 ps。剖切露出阴极（暖橙）→ 栅网 → 阳极锥的完整发射链。选热阴极而不是光阴极 RF 枪，是账 3 的直接推论：发射度预算宽松到可以买可维护性。
pois.detail_en: A triode thermionic gun on a 100 kV DC deck; the grid is modulated at 1.0 GHz (or a 25 MHz subharmonic). Bunches are pre-compressed to about 10 ps by a 250 MHz subharmonic buncher and buncher section, then squeezed to 4 ps by the magnetic chicane downstream. The cutaway shows the whole emission chain: cathode (warm orange), grid mesh, anode cone. Choosing a thermionic gun over an RF photogun follows directly from ledger 3: the emittance budget is loose enough to buy maintainability.

specs.枪型: 三极管热阴极枪，钡钨扩散阴极，100 kV DC
specs.微脉冲电荷: 200 pC（25 MHz 模式）/ 40 pC（1 GHz 模式）
specs.束团长度: 枪出口 ~10 ps → chicane 后 4 ps FWHM
specs.聚束链（账 15 定版）: 两级：SHB 18 kV(250 MHz) + 预聚束 35 kV(1 GHz)；枪脉冲 300 ps；俘获 93%

specs_en.Gun type: Triode thermionic gun, Ba-W dispenser cathode, 100 kV DC
specs_en.Micropulse charge: 200 pC (25 MHz mode) / 40 pC (1 GHz mode)
specs_en.Bunch length: about 10 ps at the gun, 4 ps FWHM after the chicane
specs_en.Peak current: 20 A at 4.1 ps with 0.02% slice spread (baseline); 36 A costs 0.53% and fails the budget - current trades against spread
specs_en.Cathode life: about 1e4 h, no drive laser, no load-lock
specs_en.Bunching chain (L15): Two stages: 18 kV SHB (250 MHz) + 35 kV prebuncher (1 GHz); 300 ps gun pulse; 93% capture

sim: 账 3 发射度判据 εn ≤ γλ/4π：150 µm 处要求 467 mm·mrad（裕度 31×），20 µm 处 109（7.3×），5 µm 处 39（2.6×）。同一支枪放到 LCLS 的 1.5 Å 上，要求 0.32 mm·mrad —— 而 LCLS 实际切片发射度 0.4，**已经压在判据线上甚至略超**。
账 3 能散预算（方和根）：RF 余弦曲率 0.008% + 束流负载瞬态 0.100% + 注入器空间电荷 0.150% + 相位抖动 0.049% + 尾场 0.080% = 0.203%，对 0.300% 预算裕度 1.5×。
账 4 chicane：35 MeV 下 Bρ = 0.1167 T·m，±1% 啁啾压 3.0→1.2 mm 需 R56 = 180 mm → 四偶极偏角 16.1°、磁场 0.164 T、横向偏置 282 mm（几何里就是这个数）。CSR 能散贡献 <0.02%。

账 15（第四轮新增，WBS 点名的全装置最薄一环）：一维宏粒子纵向追踪打通全链（枪→SHB→漂移+LSC→1 GHz 行波俘获→31 MeV→chicane），三闸门全绿（SHB 弹道焦距 0.0% / LSC 场管线 1.0% / 行波俘获渐近相位 0.8°）。**首版单级聚束被自家数据否决**：600 ps 枪脉冲 + 只有 SHB → 入口束长 ~100 ps，1 GHz RF 曲率给百分级能散——**两级聚束（SHB + 1 GHz 预聚束腔）不是优化是必需**，几何已补第三只腔。定版链：300 ps 栅控 → SHB 18 kV → 1.15 m → 预聚束 35 kV → 0.25 m → 俘获 93%。

账 15 的头号产出：**「50 A」从假设变成了权衡曲线**。账 2/9/14 一路假设 200 pC 无损落进 4 ps = 50 A；真实链给出的是**电流-切片能散的交换**：20 A @ 0.02%（近冷束）或 36 A @ 0.53%（超预算）。按账 3 的 0.3% 预算定版 **20 A / 4.1 ps / σδ 0.02%**（R56 −28 mm，chicane 偏置随之 282→110 mm，几何已改）。回灌：Z̄ 缩 0.74×、但能散折减从 0.73 回到 ~1（冷束红利），账 9 口径超模增益 1.53 → ~0.6–0.8——**仍远在 T=0.10 起振线之上，装置成立；功率口径下调 ~2×**。账 3 那句拍的「注入器空间电荷 0.15%」判定：预算行成立且保守（设计点实测 0.02%），但预算行改名「注入器+压缩链」——真正吃能散的是选高电流点时的压缩非线性。

账 20A 把账 15 的自白假设「螺线管聚焦把横向管住」变成了账：5 电流切片 RMS 包络穿全链（三道已知答案闸门——零流漂移解析、Brillouin 流恒定包络、投影发射度矩合成恒等式），匹配 B(s) 峰值 57 mT（压缩峰处，FELIX/CLIO 同型机货架量级）、γ>8 后关。头尾切片欠/过聚焦的错配增长 1.46×，加上切片内非均匀弛豫的自由能上界 ×8.4，合计 εn ≈ 11 µm vs 预算 15 µm（裕度 1.4×）。顺带闭环账 15 唯一拍的参数：束缘实算 2.9 mm → LSC 几何因子 g=4.9 vs 拍的 5.0。各末能束团表：20/25/35 MeV 交付 18–27 A、σδ ≤ 0.030%——账 19 的「同一束团」假设修订但不翻（σ_p 全部 ≪1，冷束口径处处成立）。

账 25（第十五轮）把「σ₀ = 0.9 mm 腰是设定」变成推导：100 kV 三极管枪内光学全链——自洽 Poisson 数值解复现 Child-Langmuir（偏差 −0.01%，闸门 G25a），阴极负载 1.33 A/cm² = 空间电荷限的 16%（栅控三极管正确工作区间：束流由栅压定，宏脉冲平顶不受 3/2 次方非线性影响）；阳极孔发散透镜过 Davisson-Calbick 闸门后，两旋钮匹配（B×位置）定版 **21 mT @ z=9 cm 螺线管 → SHB 入口 σ=0.86 mm、σ'=+0.6 mrad**——腰可交付，且与账 20 的 LEB 起始场 20 mT 量级自洽。发射度预算：本征 0.90 + 孔球差 0.06 + 螺线管像差 0.02 + 栅网上界 1.0（文献口径，明标）→ RSS 1.35 µm vs 预算 15 µm，裕度 11×。#1 电子枪 L1 → L2。坑 46：二分法判断枝写反后收敛到扫描上界，恰好 ×3 像物理——判断枝要跟单调性核对。

账 27/28（第十六轮）把枪和注入器的最后两个「文献口径」换成自研码实算。账 27（第五个码，EGUN 式 2D Poisson-射线自洽）：**教科书 Pierce 电极角是满空间电荷流的设计，16% SCL 栅控束用它过聚焦**（出口 −19 mrad 强会聚）——定版电极角 15°，「参数配对到工作点」的枪版实例；栅网透镜阵设计曲线定版 p=0.15 mm（εn_grid 0.82 µm ≤ 1.0 上界）；匹配点修正 76 mT @ 22 cm，腰仍可交付。账 28（第六个码，双横平面径向排序 PIC——高斯定律免网格精确场）：切片内非线性弛豫实测 **×1.46**（首段 0.1 m ≈ 四分之一等离子体波长贡献 ×1.34——归一化基点必须在 s=0），Reiser 自由能上界 ×8.4 是真上界但松 6 倍退役；**注入链发射度预算 11 → 2.8 µm，裕度 1.4× → 5×**。闸门课两条：均匀盘 + 高斯速度散不是平稳分布（只有 KV 在自洽线性力下静止），「均匀=线性」的闸门前提被 N 标度闸自我纠正；空间电荷力学约定必须与包络方程同源（perveance 正则形式，差过一个 1/(βγ)）。#1 枪 → L2.5、#2 注入器 → L3。
sim_en: Ledger 3, emittance criterion en <= gamma*lambda/4pi: 467 mm.mrad required at 150 um (31x margin), 109 at 20 um (7.3x), 39 at 5 um (2.6x). The same gun at LCLS's 1.5 A would need 0.32 mm.mrad, whereas LCLS's actual slice emittance of 0.4 already sits on - or slightly over - the line.

Ledger 3, energy-spread budget (root sum square): RF cosine curvature 0.008% + beam-loading transient 0.100% + injector space charge 0.150% + phase jitter 0.049% + wakefields 0.080% = 0.203%, a 1.5x margin against the 0.300% budget.

Ledger 4, chicane: at 35 MeV, B.rho = 0.1167 T.m. Compressing 3.0 to 1.2 mm with a +/-1% chirp needs R56 = 180 mm, giving four dipoles at 16.1 deg, 0.164 T and a 282 mm dogleg - the number the geometry is built to. CSR contributes under 0.02% energy spread.

Ledger 15 (round four; the WBS singled this out as the machine's thinnest link): 1D macroparticle longitudinal tracking through the whole chain - gun, subharmonic buncher, drift with longitudinal space charge, 1 GHz travelling-wave capture, 31 MeV, chicane. Three gates green (ballistic focus 0.0%, LSC field pipeline 1.0%, asymptotic capture phase 0.8 deg). The first single-stage design was struck down by its own data: a 600 ps gun pulse with only the SHB arrives ~100 ps long and the 1 GHz RF curvature smears percent-level energy spread across it. Two-stage bunching (SHB plus a fundamental prebuncher) is a necessity, not a refinement - a third cavity is now in the geometry. Final chain: 300 ps gated pulse, 18 kV SHB, 1.15 m drift, 35 kV prebuncher, 0.25 m, 93% capture.

Ledger 15's chief product: the '50 A' turns from an assumption into a trade-off curve. Ledgers 2/9/14 all assumed 200 pC delivered losslessly into 4 ps. The real chain trades current against slice energy spread: 20 A at 0.02% (nearly cold) or 36 A at 0.53% (over budget). Applying ledger 3's 0.3% budget fixes the baseline at 20 A / 4.1 ps / 0.02% (R56 = -28 mm; the chicane dogleg shrinks from 282 to 110 mm, already fed back into the geometry). Propagated: Z-bar shrinks 0.74x but the energy-spread reduction factor recovers from 0.73 to ~1 (cold-beam dividend), so ledger 9's supermode gain drops from 1.53 to ~0.6-0.8 - still far above the T = 0.10 lasing line. The facility stands; the power figures come down ~2x. Verdict on ledger 3's guessed '0.15% injector space charge': the budget line holds and is conservative (0.02% measured at the design point), but it is renamed 'injector + compression chain' - what actually eats energy spread is compression nonlinearity when chasing high current.

Ledger 20A turns ledger 15's stated assumption ('solenoid focusing keeps the transverse plane in hand') into an actual ledger: five current slices tracked through the full chain with an RMS envelope model (three known-answer gates - analytic zero-current drift, constant Brillouin-flow envelope, and the projected-emittance moment-composition identity). The matched B(s) peaks at 57 mT at the compression point (shelf hardware for FELIX/CLIO-class injectors) and switches off above gamma=8. Slice mismatch grows the projected emittance 1.46x; adding the free-energy bound on within-slice relaxation (x8.4) gives 11 um total against the 15 um budget - a 1.4x margin. It also closes the loop on the one parameter ledger 15 had to guess: the computed beam edge of 2.9 mm gives an LSC geometry factor g = 4.9 versus the assumed 5.0. The per-energy bunch table (20/25/35 MeV delivering 18-27 A at <=0.030% slice spread) revises but does not overturn ledger 19's same-bunch assumption: sigma_p stays well below 1 everywhere, so the cold-beam accounting holds at every final energy.

Ledger 25 (round 15) turns 'sigma_0 = 0.9 mm waist is an assumption' into a derivation: the full internal optics of the 100 kV triode gun. A self-consistent Poisson solve reproduces Child-Langmuir to -0.01% (gate G25a); the cathode runs at 1.33 A/cm2 = 16% of the space-charge limit - the correct triode regime, where the grid sets the current and the macropulse flat-top is immune to the 3/2-power nonlinearity. With the anode-aperture diverging lens gated against Davisson-Calbick, a two-knob match (solenoid strength x position) freezes at 21 mT at z = 9 cm, delivering sigma = 0.86 mm, sigma' = +0.6 mrad at the SHB - the waist is deliverable and consistent with ledger 20's ~20 mT LEB entry field. Emittance budget: 0.90 intrinsic + 0.06 aperture + 0.02 solenoid + 1.0 grid upper bound (literature figure, flagged) = 1.35 um RSS against the 15 um budget, an 11x margin. Gun rises L1 to L2. Pit 46: an inverted bisection branch converged to the scan ceiling - exactly 3x, deceptively physical-looking; check the branch against monotonicity.

Ledgers 27/28 (round 16) replace the gun and injector's last two literature figures with home-built-code numbers. Ledger 27 (fifth code, EGUN-style 2D Poisson-ray self-consistency): the textbook Pierce electrode angle is a full-space-charge-limited design - a grid-limited beam at 16% SCL gets overfocused by it (-19 mrad at exit), so the electrode is redesigned to 15 degrees, the gun-flavored instance of 'match parameters to the working point'; the grid lenslet design curve freezes at 0.15 mm pitch (0.82 um against the 1.0 um bound); the match point moves to 76 mT at 22 cm and the waist remains deliverable. Ledger 28 (sixth code, two-plane PIC with exact mesh-free radial fields from Gauss's law by sorting): the slice-internal nonlinear relaxation measures x1.46 - with x1.34 arriving in the first 10 cm, a quarter plasma wavelength, so the normalization baseline must sit at s=0 - and the Reiser free-energy bound of x8.4 retires as a true but 6x-loose ceiling. The injector emittance budget drops 11 to 2.8 um: margin 1.4x to 5x. Two gate lessons: a uniform disk with Gaussian velocities is not stationary (only KV is) - the 'uniform means linear' gate premise was corrected by its own N-scaling check; and space-charge dynamics must share the envelope equation's convention (canonical perveance form - one factor of beta*gamma apart). Gun to L2.5, injector to L3.
physics: 光阴极枪的低发射度来自冷发射与瞬时开关，代价是 Cs₂Te 靶的 QE 月级半衰、UV 驱动激光与 load-lock —— 三样东西在火星上都要从地球运。热阴极的发射度差 5 倍，但阴极只是一块金属，ops-fab-01 就能补。
发射度判据 ε ≤ λ/4π 的物理是：电子束的相空间体积不能超过一个光模的相空间体积，否则不同电子看到的光相位互相抵消。波长越长，一个光模越「胖」，越容易装下电子束。
physics_en: A photogun's low emittance comes from cold emission and instantaneous switching, at the price of a Cs2Te target whose quantum efficiency halves in a month, a UV drive laser and a load-lock - three things Mars must import. A thermionic cathode is five times worse in emittance but is just a piece of metal that ops-fab-01 can make.

The physics behind emittance <= lambda/4pi: the electron beam's phase-space volume must not exceed that of a single optical mode, otherwise different electrons see mutually cancelling optical phases. Longer wavelengths mean fatter modes, which are easier to fill.

pois.label: 常温铜直线加速器与 klystron 廊
pois.label_en: Room-Temperature Copper Linac and Klystron Gallery
pois.detail: 两节 1.0 GHz 行波盘荷铜结构（合计 7.7 m 有效长度，6.5 MV/m），各由一台 8 MW klystron 独立驱动、独立相位——两节能独立调能，这是把束能当第三个调谐旋钮用的前提。屏蔽墙把 klystron 廊与加速器厅隔开，铜波导跨墙而过：**铜=RF** 是全场第一条同色因果链。廊里能看见调制器机柜、33 kJ 电容组、脉冲变压器油箱与 klystron 聚焦螺线管。
pois.detail_en: Two 1.0 GHz travelling-wave disc-loaded copper sections (7.7 m active, 6.5 MV/m), each driven by its own 8 MW klystron with independent phase, so the two sections can be detuned in energy - the precondition for using beam energy as the third tuning knob. A shield wall separates the klystron gallery from the accelerator hall, with copper waveguides arcing over it: copper = RF is the facility's first colour-coded causal chain. The gallery shows modulator cabinets, the 33 kJ capacitor bank, the pulse-transformer oil tank and the klystron focusing solenoids.

sim: 账 4 频率选型：1.0 GHz 而非 3 GHz。硬约束是腔长 6.0 m → 往返 40 ns → 微脉冲率必须整分 25 MHz（2.998 GHz 给 119.92，不是整数）。软约束都指向低频：横向尾场 ∝ f²、纵向 ∝ f³，RF 曲率能散 ∝ f²。代价是分路阻抗 r ∝ √f，壁耗多 1.3 倍（约 3 kW 平均）—— 用 3 kW 买尾场与能散各一个量级，买。
账 4 电网冲击：不缓冲的话 klystron 阴极峰值直流 30 MW 持续 21 µs = 全城 176 MWe 的 17%。缓冲后，33 kJ 电容组在 100 ms 间隔里恒流慢充，电网只看到 7.2 kW 的**恒定**负载、纹波 <1 kW。脉冲从不出调制器机柜。
与 pwr-storage-01 的关系是「无关」而非「依赖」：储能场 31.2 MWh = 1.12e11 J，是本机单发电网能量（722 J）的 2e8 倍。夜供上限 1,569 kW 里本机占 4.7% —— 排白班是把夜间容量留给生命保障与温室补光的**政策**选择，不是电力约束。

账 9 核心 3 的**跨账审计**（账 2 和账 4 都漏了这一条）：账 4 按 klystron 峰值功率预算把 1 GHz 高平均功率模式定成 40 pC/微脉冲，4 ps 下只有 10 A；而账 9 扫出的激射阈值**随数值收敛设置在 7–11 A 之间漂**——**这个模式整个落在不确定带里面**。审计真正的产出不是「它不激射」，而是**「按现有账本判不出它激不激射」**，而一台用户装置的主力运行模式不能停在这个位置上。一个只算了 25 MHz 模式的增益，一个只算了 RF 功率，中间那条「电流够不够激射」没人管。三个修法：①1 GHz 仍用 200 pC → 束流负载 10 MW 峰值、要 4 台 klystron，否；②**把束团压到 1.5 ps → 40 pC/1.5 ps = 27 A，过阈**（代价：啁啾加大到 ~12° 离峰，定时指标随之收紧，账 13 核过仍在预算内）—— **采纳**；③降到 250 MHz 折中，备选。

账 15 对 1 GHz 高平均功率模式的终审：修法②（40 pC 压 1.5 ps）**失败**——硬压触发相空间折叠，最好 12 A 还带 2.7% 垃圾能散，仍在账 9 的 7–11 A 阈值带里；修法③（250 MHz/80 pC）**也失败**（束长压不干净）。**修法④是最终答案：别改束团，改重频**——已验证的 200 pC 工作点原样提频到 **200 MHz**（束流负载 1.24 MW < 2.0 MW 预算、整除 1 GHz、腔内 8 个光脉冲同环行=FELIX 先例）。平均功率 = 25 MHz 模式 ×8，相比原 1 GHz 目标 ÷5——**代价明码标价，换掉一个判不出激不激射的模式**。

账 20C 替账 4 和账 19 对了一次跨账：全链实测相位效率 0.77（俘获段滑相吃掉的比拍的多），设计包络 13.6 MW → 主段 ≤6.49 MV/m → 顶格 **38.1 MeV**；装机 16 MW 零裕量 → 41.8。反算 50 MeV 要主段 9.03 MV/m、RF 22.3 MW = 装机的 139%。「20–50 MeV」的上沿从铭牌上划掉，实际口径 20–38（帧内可短时冲 41.8）。顶格点束团与 35 MeV 点同口径（21 A/0.014%）。回归闸门 T0 的教训记坑 31：v1 把叙事标签「35 MeV」当锚判了假 FAIL——账 15 冻结输出的定版数是 30.9 MeV@6.2 m。回归锚抄冻结输出，不抄叙事标签。

账 21（第九轮）把分路阻抗从文献口径变成 HFSS 数：药盒 TM010 三道解析闸门先验通提取管线（f +0.20%、Q −0.1%、r/Q −1.6%），再解 1 GHz 盘荷三胞——**r = 35.3 MΩ/m ±15%**（账 4 取 28）、Q 22909、v_g 0.70% c。头号发现：**行波馈电效率 1−e^(−2τ) 是账 4 漏记的一整项**（透传功率进负载，SLAC 缩放虹膜下效率仅 0.64）。虹膜半径是本册从未定版的自由参数：定版 a = 30 mm（τ = 0.67、效率 0.74、填充 4.9 µs）。两个反向错误几乎对消（漏记的效率 ×0.74 vs 低估的 r ×1.26），顶格 38.1 → **37.0 MeV（包络）/ 40.6（装机）**。连带：填充 4.9 + 束流 20 = 24.9 µs ≈ klystron 25 µs 脉宽——账 17 的「宏脉冲拉长」免费功率旋钮被填充时间关死，播种旋钮尚存。

账 21 的闸门课（两真一诚实）：EditSources 选模是**死旋钮**（嵌套列表签名被 HFSS 静默吞掉，4 个模的轴场逐位全同才暴露——「自变量动没动答案」闸的教科书案例；位置参数签名才生效）；三胞 E 壁端接实际采样的相移是 {3°, 83°, 150°} 而非想当然的 {0°, 60°, 120°}（E3/E4 两道闸诚实 FAIL 并归因，各模相移由 V(k) 同步积分峰位实测替代假设指派）——r 因此挂 ±15% 方法带，顶格 ∓7%，10 µm 边界在下界 34.5 MeV 也点火（7.9 µJ）= 口径稳健。单胞 master/slave 周期解是 L4 级修法，记下一轮。

账 23（第十一轮）单胞 master/slave 周期解把账 21 的 ±15% 方法带收口到 ±5%：周期解的复场是**真行波**（轴场端到端 Bloch 相位推进实测 +115°，闸门 P1），r/Q = |∫Ez e^(−jkz)dz|²/(ωU) 直接成立——驻波 ×2 换算与三胞端接采样两个假设从账里退场。定版虹膜 a = 30 mm 处全量实测：**r = 37.5 MΩ/m（±5%）**、Q 22864、v_g 0.599% c（替换标度外推 0.527）；馈电账全实测口径 τ 0.59/效率 0.69/填充 4.3 µs（≤5 ✓）；**顶格 37.0/40.6 MeV 与账 21 独立方法互证不动**——机器铭牌站稳，波段与功率表沿用。三条新坑：新设计忘调 EditSources（默认峰值 1 V/m 归一 ≠ 1 J 储能归一，r/Q 直接归零，体积分交叉核 0.989 J 把关）；Bloch 场相位约定 e^(+jβz)（同步核取共轭）；V(k) 峰位定位是多胞窗口的仪器（单周期 sinc 宽 ±2π），判据要随窗口换——单胞用相位推进判同步。WBS #3 主加速器升 L3.5。

账 29（第十六轮）束流线系统工程双账。定时链：光纤热漂系数从材料参数推出（38.1 fs/m/K，闸门对文献 37）——洞室 ±0.1 K 下 2/6 短链免主动稳相（**地表 ±10 K 同链漂 22.8 ps，全部得主动——真·火星地下红利**）；4 长链主动（往返检相 + 压电，残余 20 fs）；分配层 RSS 92 fs = 预算 200 fs 的 46%，账 13 那条 1.16× 最薄裕度的瓶颈确认在 RF/LLRF 不在光纤。klystron 备件账（26 个月会合周期没有『坏了下单』）：随机通道 Poisson（解析 vs MC 闸）整管备 1 只断供率 1.3%；阴极磨损计划通道 4.6 年/管错峰备 2 套；非计划停机 0.2 天/年；**单管降额模式顶格 26.6 MeV——坏一只管子是降波段（≥20 µm 维持）不是停机**。#4 RF 源/定时 → L1.5。

账 34（第十九轮）真空系统清账：**规格溯源定案——束流对真空零要求**（1e-8 mbar × 30 m 的束-气散射 Δεn ~1e-10 µm，预算的 4e-11），规格全部来自部件：枪 1e-7 mbar + H₂O/O₂ 分压条款（钡钨阴极中毒；CO₂ 相对无害）、linac 1e-8（RF 击穿惯例）、腔区无油（金镜烃裂解）。**导抽暴政**：盘荷结构⌀60 mm×7.7 m 整根导抽只有 3.4 l/s——未烘烤中点超压超规格 ×118 泵无解，**烘烤是结构性前提**（150 ℃ 在位、波荡器段隔断 <80 ℃）。一维压强网络码把账 4 的「40 只离子泵」功率行变成摆位设计：24 只 ×75 l/s 全段达标（最紧波荡器室 80×）。**锚审计跨账更正：账 31 差分抽气压比 2.3e4 系十倍口误平方——真值 ~280 vs 需求 100，裁决不翻、裕度 2.8×**（第三级孔为廉价备份）。吹扫气 = 干燥火星 CO₂ 白送。三闸全绿。#14 → L2。
sim_en: Ledger 4, frequency choice: 1.0 GHz rather than 3 GHz. The hard constraint is that the 6.0 m cavity's 40 ns round trip forces the micropulse rate to divide 25 MHz exactly (2.998 GHz gives 119.92, not an integer). Every soft constraint also points low: transverse wakefields scale as f^2, longitudinal as f^3, and RF curvature energy spread as f^2. The cost is shunt impedance scaling as sqrt(f), so 1.3x more wall loss - about 3 kW average - which buys an order of magnitude in both wakefields and energy spread.

Ledger 4, grid impact: unbuffered, the klystron cathodes would draw 30 MW peak DC for 21 us, 17% of the colony's 176 MWe. Buffered, the 33 kJ bank is trickle-charged over the 100 ms interval and the grid sees a steady 7.2 kW with under 1 kW of ripple. The pulse never leaves the modulator cabinet.

The relationship with pwr-storage-01 is independence, not dependence: the storage farm's 31.2 MWh (1.12e11 J) is 2e8 times this machine's 722 J per shot. The FEL is 4.7% of the 1,569 kW night ceiling - running on the day shift is a policy choice that keeps night capacity for life support and greenhouse lighting, not an electrical constraint.

Ledger 9's third core result is a cross-ledger audit that both ledger 2 and ledger 4 missed. Ledger 4 set the 1 GHz high-average-power mode at 40 pC per micropulse from the klystron peak-power budget, which at 4 ps is only 10 A - while ledger 9's threshold scan puts the lasing threshold anywhere from 7 to 11 A depending on numerical convergence settings - the mode falls entirely inside that uncertainty band. The audit's real output is not that it fails to lase but that the existing ledgers cannot tell, and a user facility's main operating mode cannot sit there. One ledger computed gain only for the 25 MHz mode, the other computed only RF power, and nobody checked whether the resulting current still lases. Three fixes: keep 200 pC at 1 GHz, which means 10 MW of beam loading and four klystrons - rejected; compress the bunch to 1.5 ps so 40 pC gives 27 A and clears threshold, at the cost of about 12 degrees off crest and a tighter timing spec that ledger 13 confirms still fits - adopted; or drop to 250 MHz as a fallback.

Ledger 15's final ruling on the 1 GHz high-average-power mode: fix 2 (40 pC squeezed to 1.5 ps) fails - hard compression folds the phase space, yielding at best 12 A with 2.7% junk energy spread, still inside ledger 9's 7-11 A threshold band; fix 3 (250 MHz, 80 pC) also fails. Fix 4 is the answer: change the repetition rate, not the bunch. The proven 200 pC working point is simply run at 200 MHz - 1.24 MW beam loading inside the 2.0 MW budget, an exact divisor of 1 GHz, eight optical pulses circulating in the cavity as at FELIX. Average power becomes 8x the 25 MHz mode, a factor 5 below the original 1 GHz ambition - a price printed on the tag, in exchange for retiring a mode whose lasing could not even be adjudicated.

Ledger 20C runs the cross-check that ledgers 4 and 19 each thought the other owned: with the full-chain measured phase efficiency of 0.77 (capture-section phase slippage costs more than assumed), the 13.6 MW design envelope caps the main-section gradient at 6.49 MV/m and the final energy at 38.1 MeV; the 16 MW installed limit gives 41.8 MeV with zero margin. Reaching 50 MeV would take 9.03 MV/m and 22.3 MW - 139% of installed power - so the '20-50 MeV' top line comes off the nameplate: the honest range is 20-38 MeV (41.8 in short bursts of margin-free running). The ceiling-point bunch matches the 35 MeV point (21 A / 0.014%). Regression gate T0 also left a lesson (pit 31): v1 anchored on the narrative label '35 MeV' and threw a false FAIL - the frozen ledger-15 output says 30.9 MeV at 6.2 m. Regression anchors come from frozen outputs, not from narrative labels.

Ledger 21 (round 9) turns the shunt impedance from a literature number into an HFSS one: three analytic pillbox gates validate the extraction pipeline first (f +0.20%, Q -0.1%, r/Q -1.6%), then the 1 GHz disk-loaded 3-cell stack yields r = 35.3 MOhm/m +-15% (ledger 4 assumed 28), Q = 22909, vg = 0.70% c. Headline: the traveling-wave feed efficiency 1-exp(-2*tau) is a whole term ledger 4 never booked - power transmitted out of the structure into the load, only 0.64 efficient at the SLAC-scaled iris. The iris radius, never frozen in this book, becomes the design knob: a = 30 mm (tau 0.67, efficiency 0.74, 4.9 us fill). Two opposite errors nearly cancel (the unbooked x0.74 efficiency against the underestimated x1.26 impedance), so the ceiling moves 38.1 to 37.0 MeV (envelope) / 40.6 (installed). Corollary: 4.9 us fill + 20 us beam = 24.9 us against the 25 us klystron pulse - ledger 17's 'stretch the macropulse' free-power knob is now closed by fill time; seeding survives.

Ledger 21's gate lessons (two catches, one honest pair): the eigenmode EditSources call was a dead knob - HFSS silently swallowed the nested-list signature, exposed only when all four exported mode fields came back bit-identical (a textbook 'did the knob move the answer' gate; the positional signature works). And the 3-cell E-wall termination actually samples phase advances of {3, 83, 150} degrees, not the assumed {0, 60, 120}: gates E3/E4 FAIL honestly with attribution, and each mode's phase is measured from its V(k) synchronous-integral peak instead of assigned. The impedance therefore carries a +-15% method band, the ceiling -+7%, and the 10 um boundary still lases at the 34.5 MeV lower edge (7.9 uJ) - the published band is robust to it. A single-cell master/slave periodic solve is the L4-grade fix, queued next.

Ledger 23 (round 11): a single-cell master/slave periodic solve collapses ledger 21's +-15% method band to +-5%. The periodic eigenfield is a genuine traveling wave (measured end-to-end Bloch phase advance +115 deg, gate P1), so r/Q = |int Ez exp(-jkz) dz|^2/(wU) holds directly - both the standing-wave x2 conversion and the 3-cell termination sampling leave the books. At the frozen a = 30 mm iris everything is measured: r = 37.5 MOhm/m (+-5%), Q = 22864, vg = 0.599% c (replacing the 0.527 scaling extrapolation); the feed account runs on measured numbers (tau 0.59, efficiency 0.69, 4.3 us fill, within the 5 us budget); and the ceiling stays at 37.0/40.6 MeV - two independent methods now agree, the nameplate stands, band and power table carry over. Three new pits: a fresh design forgot EditSources (default peak-1V/m normalization instead of 1 J stored energy zeroed r/Q; the 0.989 J volume-integral cross-check guards it), the Bloch field phase convention is exp(+j beta z) (conjugate the synchronous kernel), and V(k) peak localization is a multi-cell-window instrument (single-period sinc width +-2pi) - the criterion must match the window; a single cell judges synchronism by phase advance. WBS #3 rises to L3.5.

Ledger 29 (round 16), two systems-engineering accounts for the beamline. Timing: the fiber thermal coefficient is derived from material parameters (38.1 fs/m/K, gated against the literature 37) - under the cavern's +-0.1 K, two of six short links need no active stabilization at all (on the surface at +-10 K the same links would drift 22.8 ps and every one would need it: a genuine Mars-underground dividend); the four long links run round-trip phase detection with piezo trim (20 fs residual). The distribution layer closes at 92 fs RSS = 46% of the 200 fs budget, confirming ledger 13's thinnest margin lives in the RF/LLRF chain, not the fiber. Klystron spares (a 26-month synodic cycle allows no 'order-on-failure'): the random channel is Poisson-priced (analytic vs MC gate) - one spare tube holds stock-out risk at 1.3%; cathode wear is a scheduled channel at 4.6 years per tube, staggered with two cathode kits; unscheduled downtime ~0.2 days/year; and in single-tube derated mode the ceiling is 26.6 MeV - losing a tube narrows the band (20 um and up keeps running) rather than stopping the machine. RF/timing rises to L1.5.

Ledger 34 (round 19) settles the vacuum system: **spec provenance decided - the beam itself needs no vacuum** (beam-gas scattering at 1e-8 mbar x 30 m gives emittance growth ~1e-10 um, 4e-11 of budget); every spec comes from components: gun 1e-7 mbar plus an H2O/O2 partial-pressure clause (dispenser-cathode poisoning; CO2 is relatively benign), linac 1e-8 (RF-breakdown convention), cavity oil-free (hydrocarbon cracking on gold mirrors). **Conductance tyranny**: the disk-loaded structure (60 mm bore x 7.7 m) has an end-to-end conductance of just 3.4 l/s - unbaked, the midpoint pressure bump exceeds spec by 118x and no pump can help, so **bakeout is a structural precondition** (150 C in-situ, undulator section isolated below 80 C). A 1D pressure-network code turns ledger 4's '40 ion pumps' power-table line into a placement design: 24 pumps x 75 l/s meet spec everywhere (tightest: undulator chamber, 80x). **Anchor audit, cross-ledger correction: ledger 31's differential-pumping ratio of 2.3e4 was a tenfold slip squared - true value ~280 vs required 100; the verdict stands, margin 2.8x** (a third stage is a cheap backup). Purge gas = dry Mars CO2, free. All three gates green. Subsystem #14 -> L2.
physics: 行波结构里 RF 以群速度沿铜管爬行，电子骑在波峰上被持续加速；盘荷虹膜把相速度压到 c，否则电子会跑赢波。屏上跑动的相位灯就是这列行波。
常温铜的代价是壁耗 ∝ E²/r 与占空比：不能连续波运行。但账 2 证明 20 µs 宏脉冲够振荡器建立并饱和 77% 的时间，用户拿到 0.83 W 平均功率 —— 常温不是妥协，是在火星唯一可行的选择（见定位卡的氦账）。
physics_en: In a travelling-wave structure the RF crawls along the copper at the group velocity while electrons surf the crest; the disc-loading irises drag the phase velocity down to c, otherwise the electrons would outrun the wave. The running phase lamps are that wave.

Room-temperature copper costs wall power (proportional to E^2/r) and duty cycle: continuous-wave operation is impossible. But ledger 2 shows a 20 us macropulse lets the oscillator build up and stay saturated for 77% of the pulse, delivering 0.83 W average - so 'warm' is not a compromise but the only option on Mars.

pois.label: 可调间隙波荡器（剖切）与三个调谐旋钮
pois.label_en: Variable-Gap Undulator (cutaway) and the Three Tuning Knobs
pois.detail: λu = 65 mm × 40 周期的混合式永磁波荡器，NdFeB 磁块与钒坡莫合金极靴交替排列（红=N、蓝=S），间隙 16–48 mm 由两根同步丝杠驱动。+Z 侧机架全开=剖切，磁阵一览无余；旁边 6× 放大的三周期教学台把 28 mm 的真实间隙放大到能看清摆动轨迹。三个旋钮：周期（造死）、间隙→K（秒级）、束能→γ（分钟级）。波荡器不耗一瓦励磁功率。
pois.detail_en: A hybrid permanent-magnet undulator, 65 mm period x 40, with NdFeB blocks alternating with vanadium-permendur poles (red = N, blue = S) and a 16-48 mm gap driven by two synchronised lead screws. The frame is open on the +Z side - a full cutaway of the magnet array - and a 6x enlarged three-period teaching stand beside it blows the real 28 mm gap up to where the wiggle trajectory is legible. Three knobs: period (fixed at manufacture), gap to K (seconds), beam energy to gamma (minutes). The undulator draws zero excitation power.

specs.磁体: NdFeB 混合式，B0 = 3.33·exp(−5.47x+1.80x²) T（x = 间隙/λu）
specs.间隙公差: Δg ≤ 11.9 µm 全长（对应 ΔB/B ≤ 0.1%）
specs.相位误差: σφ ≤ 10° rms（增益折减 0.97），逐极垫片整形
specs.励磁功率: 0 W —— 永磁，火星上最省心的一件设备
specs.长波波导: 平行板 b = 10 mm，**水平板 = TE 模**（TEM 取向会损失 69%/3 m）
specs.间隙重复性: ≤ 5 µm（编码器 1 µm）—— 两条独立判据同量级互证

specs_en.Magnets: NdFeB hybrid, B0 = 3.33 exp(-5.47x + 1.80x^2) T with x = gap/period
specs_en.Gap tolerance: 11.9 um over the full length, for dB/B under 0.1%
specs_en.Phase error: under 10 deg rms (0.97 gain reduction), achieved by pole-by-pole shimming
specs_en.Excitation power: zero - permanent magnets, the most maintenance-free item on site
specs_en.Long-wave waveguide: Parallel plates, 10 mm gap, horizontal = TE mode (TEM orientation would lose 69% over 3 m)
specs_en.Magnet temperature: +/-0.1 K underground gives 0.014% wavelength drift; +/-10 K on the surface would give 1.44%
specs_en.Gap repeatability: <= 5 um with 1 um encoder - two independent criteria agree

sim: 账 1 调谐表（间隙 → K → λ）：间隙 47.5 mm/K 0.97 → 5 µm @50 MeV；33.5 mm/K 1.94 → 20 µm @35 MeV；23.4 mm/K 3.57 → 100 µm @25 MeV；23.7 mm/K 3.48 → 150 µm @20 MeV。机器包络 4.9–386 µm，发布 5–150 µm → 账 19 修订 6.5–150（5 µm 点火失败）→ 账 20 二修 **10–150 µm**（50 MeV 买不起，顶格 38.1 MeV；表中 5 µm@50 MeV 一行是纸面参数）。
账 1 长波边界不是物理是净空：λ = 150 µm 时最优高斯模在波荡器端部全宽 24.0 mm，已逼近 24 mm 间隙——λ ≳ 100 µm 必须插 10 mm 净空平行板波导（FELIX FEL-1 同款），代价 ~2%/程附加损耗。
账 6 机械：最小间隙下两颚磁吸力 57.9 kN（5.9 吨力），是单颚磁块自重（火星 174 N）的 334 倍 —— **0.38 g 在这里一分钱也省不下**，这是本设计册第一条「火星红利不成立」的账。按 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≤ 11.9 µm 反推，梁需 I ≥ 5.58e-3 m⁴，折合 0.40 m 宽 × 0.55 m 高。剖切里那两根粗梁不是装饰。

账 10d 长波端的真账（账 1 只写了「插波导」）：自由空间模式在波荡器端部的全宽在 100 µm 处已达间隙的 84%、150 µm 处 101% → 每程截断损耗 3.4% / 9.5%，往返近 20%，**这不是可选项，是长波端能不能用的分界线**。而波导可行与否取决于一个取向选择：平行板波导里 E 垂直于板走 TEM 模，α = 2R_s/(ηb) = 0.20 Np/m，3 m 吃掉 **69%**；E 平行于板走 TE₁ 模，多一个 (f_c/f)² 因子（b≫λ 时 ~1e-5），3 m 只掉 **0.007%**。平面波荡器的辐射是水平线偏振、波导板是上下两块水平板 → 天然落在 TE 分支。**同一副波导转 90° 就报废，差 4 个量级。**

账 13b 波长稳定度里波荡器占的两项：①磁体温度——NdFeB 可逆温度系数 −0.11 %/K，经 δλ/λ = [K²/(1+K²/2)]·δK/K 放大 1.31 倍 → **0.144 %/K**。洞室的 ±0.1 K 给 0.014%（谱宽的 3%）；同一台机器放地面，HVAC 一般的 ±10 K 给 1.44% = 谱宽的 **288%**，一天之内谱线走出自己的线宽三次。**这是 30 m 岩最硬的一条兑现**，而且不依赖任何机械方案。②间隙机械重复性：由 δλ/λ ≤ 0.1% 反推 δg ≤ 6.8 µm，与账 6 由 ΔB/B ≤ 0.1% 定的 11.9 µm 落在同一量级、互为背书 → 定版 **重复性 ≤5 µm、编码器 1 µm**。

账 16（第四轮）：波导内 FEL 增益，把长波端从「自由空间外推」变成「算出」。两闸门（y 向重叠闭式 ½(1+e^(−2(πσ/b)²)) 精确复现 / 自由空间口径恒等式）全绿。**波导把模式竖向钳在 b/2 有效高度 → 耦合面积缩小 → 单程增益放大 1.2×(50 µm)/1.7×(100 µm)/2.1×(150 µm)**，同时免掉 3–10%/程截断损耗——长波端净往返增益从 ~0.2 抬到 ~1.5 量级，**真正的限制回到取出孔（账 14）**。群速滑移（≤2% 的 Nλ）与共振偏移（≤0.03%）都算过并判可忽略；15 MeV 扩展模式（→685 µm）的耦合外推 ~4–6×，但注入器在 15 MeV 未验证，扩展模式维持 L0.5 不随本账升级。

账 19 点火边界扫描：@50 MeV 上探 6.5/8/10/13 µm，6.5 µm 首点即过（一维增益 0.380、12.1 µJ、建立 165 圈），三维复核确认（单圈 0.224、饱和 7.4 µJ、建立 10.6 µs、已收敛）。三维/一维 = 0.61——账 17 的「冷束点三维罚金归零」只在增益厚的波段成立，薄增益区（边界附近）罚金回来了。边界步进一档 ±（6.5 之下直接是 5 µm 的死区），发布短波端取 6.5 µm。

账 20D 在真实顶格 38.1 MeV 重扫边界：6.5 µm 的 K 掉到 0.47、增益 −0.003（死）；8 µm 增益 0.219 建立不起；10 µm 一维 0.498/10.5 µJ，三维 500 圈确认 6.5 µJ、建立 8.8 µs。边界点的 T 选择反转：一维在厚增益区选 T=0.10，三维薄增益区 T=0.05 反超（6.53 vs 4.31 µJ、建立 8.8 vs 15.3 µs）——低取出率降阈值加快建立，账 14「低 T 腔内场强饱和深」的逻辑在边界处更狠。三维/一维比值链：20 µm 1.07 → 6.5 µm 0.61 → 10 µm@38 MeV 0.51——「冷束免三维罚金」严格限于厚增益区。坑 32：v2 用 300 圈判死一个尾部还 +14%/圈的点——判据必须区分「不点火」与「建立慢」，边界点一律 500 圈跑透。

账 24（第十二轮）把功率表最后一个非 3D 口径清账：自研第四个数值码——板几何 2.5D 时变振荡器（纵向沿用一维核，x 向 FFT 傍轴，y 向保持账 16 的 TE₁ 解析钳模）。耦合常数解析构造（W_eff=∫u²dx），模锁参考跑严格退化为一维——回归闸门 W3b 免调参过（0.700 vs 0.701）。自由跑：细线束（σx=0.21 mm ≪ 模 8.5 mm）的增益导引不足以补回模式失配，单横维罚 ~36%（外推口径）vs 账 14 圆几何双横维罚 30%。小信号增益不随步长收敛（细线源自身瑞利距离 0.93 mm ≪ dz=65 mm，δ 源近场一步内衍射掉）但**饱和输出收敛**（自限）：Richardson 外推带 6.1–6.4 µJ，**150 µm 行发布 6.1 µJ（取带下缘保守，1.5D 的 5.85 上调 4%）**。能量闭合 W3c2 诚实 FAIL 带归因（一阶欧拉 + 亚网格源自能，均 O(h)，步长减半实验钉死）；「传播源核」修法与 y 向多模竞争记升级项。

账 30（第十七轮）把光侧最浅的子系统清账：第七个自研码——解析块场叠加（Radia-lite，均匀磁化长方体的闭式场精确到机器精度，328 块直接叠加；偶极远场 0.00%、∇·B 2e-7、PPM 闭式对账三闸全绿——阵场对闭式的 −3~−7% 偏差是有限块宽横向滚降的物理指纹）。**PPM 裁决：纯永磁在 g=16 mm 给 K=5.86 贴线覆盖——指定 N48（Br≥1.36 T）得 5% 裕度，非线性极靴按主线退场**、hybrid 降为保险。**端部设计从 I₁=I₂=0 解出来：四旋钮最小范数解自己长出经典「半强度端块」（首/末块 −0.50/−0.52），残差 0.00 µrad/µm 免校正线圈**。相位误差从指标变成账：未分选（Br±1%/易轴±1°）φ_rms = 57°±48°（12 座 MC）——**分选+垫片整形是达到 ≤10° 的必需工艺**，入采购要求。#7 波荡器 L1 → L2.5。
sim_en: Ledger 1 tuning table (gap to K to wavelength): 47.5 mm / K 0.97 gives 5 um at 50 MeV; 33.5 mm / K 1.94 gives 20 um at 35 MeV; 23.4 mm / K 3.57 gives 100 um at 25 MeV; 23.7 mm / K 3.48 gives 150 um at 20 MeV. The machine envelope is 4.9-386 um; the published band was 5-150 um, revised to 6.5-150 um by ledger 19 (5 um fails to lase), then to 10-150 um by ledger 20 (50 MeV is unaffordable; the real ceiling is 38.1 MeV, so the 5 um @ 50 MeV row above is paper-only).

Ledger 1: the long-wavelength limit is clearance, not physics. At 150 um the optimal Gaussian mode is 24.0 mm across at the undulator ends, already at the 24 mm gap - so beyond about 100 um a 10 mm parallel-plate waveguide must be inserted (as in FELIX FEL-1), costing roughly 2% extra loss per pass.

Ledger 6, mechanics: at minimum gap the jaws attract each other with 57.9 kN (5.9 tonnes force), 334 times the Mars weight of one magnet array (174 N). Low gravity buys nothing here - the first entry in this design book where the Mars dividend does not exist. Inverting delta = 5wL^4/(384EI) <= 11.9 um demands I >= 5.58e-3 m^4, i.e. a 0.40 x 0.55 m girder. The two heavy beams in the cutaway are structural, not decorative.

Ledger 10d gives the long-wavelength story that ledger 1 only gestured at. In free space the mode's full width at the undulator ends already reaches 84% of the gap at 100 um and 101% at 150 um, costing 3.4% and 9.5% clipping per pass - nearly 20% per round trip. A waveguide is therefore not optional but the dividing line for the long-wavelength end. Whether it works at all turns on one orientation choice: with E perpendicular to the plates the mode is TEM with alpha = 2Rs/(eta*b) = 0.20 Np/m, losing 69% over 3 m; with E parallel to the plates it is TE1, carrying an extra (fc/f)^2 factor of about 1e-5 for b >> lambda, losing 0.007% over the same 3 m. A planar undulator radiates horizontally polarised light and the waveguide plates are horizontal, so the field lands on the TE branch by nature. Rotate the same waveguide by 90 degrees and it is useless - four orders of magnitude ride on the orientation.

Ledger 13b covers the undulator's two contributions to wavelength stability. First, magnet temperature: NdFeB's reversible coefficient of -0.11 %/K is amplified 1.31x by d(lambda)/lambda = [K^2/(1+K^2/2)]*dK/K, giving 0.144 %/K. The cavern's +/-0.1 K yields 0.014%, three percent of the linewidth; the same machine on the surface with a typical +/-10 K would drift 1.44%, or 288% of the linewidth - the line would walk out of its own width three times a day. This is the hardest thing the 30 m of rock buys, and it depends on no mechanical scheme at all. Second, gap repeatability: requiring under 0.1% wavelength drift gives 6.8 um, the same order as the 11.9 um that ledger 6 derived from dB/B <= 0.1%, the two independent criteria backing each other up. Baseline: 5 um repeatability with 1 um encoder resolution.

Ledger 16 (round four): FEL gain inside the waveguide, turning the long-wavelength end from free-space extrapolation into calculation. Both gates green (the closed-form transverse overlap reproduced exactly; the free-space identity check). The waveguide clamps the mode to an effective half-gap height, shrinking the coupling area and boosting single-pass gain by 1.2x at 50 um, 1.7x at 100 um and 2.1x at 150 um, while eliminating the 3-10% per-pass clipping loss - net round-trip gain at the long end rises from about 0.2 to order 1.5, so the real limit moves back to the outcoupling hole (ledger 14). Group-velocity slippage (under 2% of the slippage length) and the resonance shift (under 0.03%) are computed and dismissed. The 15 MeV extension mode's coupling extrapolates to 4-6x, but the injector is unverified at 15 MeV, so that mode stays at L0.5.

Ledger 19 lasing-boundary scan: stepping up from the dead 5 um point at 50 MeV through 6.5/8/10/13 um, the first candidate 6.5 um already passes (1D gain 0.380, 12.1 uJ, 165 round trips) and the 3D re-check confirms it (single-pass 0.224, saturated 7.4 uJ, 10.6 us build-up, converged). The 3D/1D ratio is 0.61: ledger 17's 'cold beam erases the 3D penalty' holds only where gain is thick; near the boundary the penalty returns. The published short edge is set at 6.5 um.

Ledger 20D rescans the boundary at the real 38.1 MeV ceiling: at 6.5 um K collapses to 0.47 and the gain to -0.003 (dead); 8 um gains 0.219 but cannot build up; 10 um gives 0.498 / 10.5 uJ in 1D and the 500-pass 3D run confirms 6.5 uJ with an 8.8 us build-up. The outcoupling choice flips at the boundary: 1D picks T=0.10 in the thick-gain regime, but in 3D at thin gain T=0.05 wins (6.53 vs 4.31 uJ, build-up 8.8 vs 15.3 us) - lower outcoupling lowers threshold and speeds build-up, ledger 14's 'low T drives the cavity field deeper into saturation' logic biting harder at the edge. The 3D/1D ratio chain now reads 1.07 at 20 um, 0.61 at 6.5 um, 0.51 at 10 um @ 38 MeV: the 'cold beam erases the 3D penalty' result is strictly a thick-gain statement. Pit 32: v2 declared a point dead at 300 passes while its tail was still growing at +14% per pass - the criterion must distinguish 'does not lase' from 'builds slowly'; boundary points get 500 passes.

Ledger 24 (round 12) clears the last non-3D entry in the power table with a fourth home-built numerical code: a slab-geometry 2.5D time-dependent oscillator (the 1D core longitudinally, FFT paraxial optics in x, and ledger 16's analytic TE1 clamp in y). The coupling constant is constructed analytically (W_eff = int u^2 dx), so the mode-locked reference run reduces exactly to 1D - regression gate W3b passes with no tuning knob (0.700 vs 0.701). In the free run, gain guiding from the pencil beam (sigma_x = 0.21 mm against an 8.5 mm mode) cannot buy back the mode mismatch: the single-transverse-dimension penalty is ~36% (extrapolated), sitting next to ledger 14's 30% for the round two-dimension geometry. Small-signal gain does not converge with step size (the pencil source's own Rayleigh range of 0.93 mm is far below the 65 mm step, so its near field diffracts away within one step) but the saturated output does: the Richardson band is 6.1-6.4 uJ, and the 150 um row publishes 6.1 uJ (conservative band edge; the 1.5D 5.85 moves up 4%). Energy closure W3c2 is an honest FAIL with attribution (first-order Euler plus sub-grid source self-energy, both O(h), pinned by the step-halving experiment); the propagated-source kernel and TE3 mode competition are queued as upgrades.

Ledger 30 (round 17) clears the shallowest light-side subsystem with a seventh home-built code: analytic block-field superposition (Radia-lite - the closed-form field of a uniformly magnetized box is machine-precision exact; 328 blocks summed directly; three gates green: far-field dipole 0.00%, div B 2e-7, PPM closed form - the -3 to -7% array deviation is the physical fingerprint of finite block width). The PPM verdict: pure permanent magnets deliver K = 5.86 at the 16 mm gap right on the line - specifying N48 grade (Br >= 1.36 T) buys 5% margin, so the nonlinear poles retire from the baseline with hybrid kept as insurance. The end termination is solved, not copied: a four-knob minimum-norm solution for zero first and second field integrals grows the classic half-strength end block on its own (-0.50/-0.52 on the outer pair), with 0.00 urad/um residuals and no correction coils. Phase error becomes an account: unsorted blocks (Br 1%, easy-axis 1 deg) give phi_rms = 57 +- 48 deg across 12 Monte-Carlo machines - sorting plus shimming is the mandatory path to the 10 deg spec, now a procurement requirement. Undulator rises L1 to L2.5.
physics: K = eB₀λu/(2πm_ec) 是电子横向摆动角与 1/γ 的比值。K 大 → 摆得宽 → 纵向速度慢 → 波长长；所以开合间隙就是在改波长，而且是连续的、秒级的。
K 还进 Bessel 因子 [JJ] = J₀(ξ)−J₁(ξ)（ξ = K²/(4+2K²)），K 越大耦合越弱一点 —— 长波端增益的下降有一半来自它。
physics_en: K = eB0*lambda_u/(2 pi m_e c) is the ratio of the electron's transverse wiggle angle to 1/gamma. Larger K means a wider wiggle, a slower longitudinal velocity and a longer wavelength - so opening the gap changes the wavelength continuously, in seconds.
K also enters the Bessel factor [JJ] = J0(xi) - J1(xi) with xi = K^2/(4+2K^2); larger K couples slightly more weakly, and half the gain roll-off at the long-wavelength end comes from this.

pois.detail: 6.00 m 长的稳定腔，两面金镀铜球面镜坐在同一块 6.5 m 殷钢台上（共模化，见下），下游镜带取出孔并配孔径轮，取出率按波长在 15–35% 之间换档。腔长 6.00 m ↔ 往返 40 ns ↔ 25 MHz 微脉冲率；1 GHz 模式下腔内同时环行 40 个光脉冲，各自与自己那一列电子束团同步。腔长由 He-Ne 干涉仪 + 压电镜座伺服锁定。
pois.detail_en: A 6.00 m stable resonator with two gold-on-copper spherical mirrors sitting on one 6.5 m Invar bench (common-mode - see below). The downstream mirror is hole-coupled through a selectable aperture wheel, with outcoupling switched between 15% and 35% depending on wavelength. The 6.00 m length gives a 40 ns round trip and a 25 MHz micropulse rate; in 1 GHz mode forty optical pulses circulate simultaneously, each synchronised to its own train of electron bunches. Cavity length is locked by a He-Ne interferometer driving piezo mirror mounts.

sim: 账 2 闸门 A（已知答案）：Ming Xie 三维拟合代 LCLS（13.6 GeV, 1.5 Å, I = 3.4 kA, εn = 0.4 µm）→ ρ = 4.83e-4，Lg_1D = 2.853 m，Λ = 0.188，**Lg_3D = 3.39 m**，对公布的 ~3.3 m 偏 +2.7% → PASS。饱和长度 20 Lg = 68 m，与 LCLS 实际用到的 60–80 m 波荡器吻合。
账 2 闸门 B/B2：一维摆方程数值积分复现三阶微扰的 Madey 线型 −d/dν[sinc²(ν/2)]，峰位 ν=2.60（解析 2.606）、全线型偏差 0.08%；把真实物理常数灌进摆方程端到端算单程增益，与解析 Madey 公式比值 **1.0000**。顺带纠正一处常见口径混淆：峰值系数在 ν 变量下是 0.27008，文献常见的 0.5403 是对 ν/2 求导的值。
账 2 折减：能散 0.715 × 滑移 0.60（20 µm）× 角散 0.98 → 单程 88%。角散折减全域 ≥0.97 —— 这就是「选红外」买到的东西。
账 2 取出率优化（目标 = 取出率 × 饱和段时长）：宏脉冲 10→20 µs 使饱和占空从 ~4 成升到 ~7 成、出光能量翻 2.4 倍 → **定版 20 µs**。同时证明取出镜必须可换：5 µm 端与 20 µm 端最优取出率差 2 倍。
账 6 腔长：城市隔振线 1.2e-6 m/s/√Hz@10 m 积分出地面位移 190 nm rms（1–100 Hz）；两面镜分锚在地面、相距 6 m，差分位移 119 nm —— 对 0.1 µm 窄带指标**裕度 0.8×，等于没有裕度**。共模化（一块 f1=80 Hz、Q=20 的殷钢台）把它压到 24 nm。**城市隔振线本身不够，解法是共模化不是更严的隔振线。**

账 9（时变一维振荡器，本轮新增）**推翻账 2 的增益数**：多切片 + 滑移 + 腔反馈的自洽解给出超模每程小信号增益 **1.53**，账 2 的 0.88 低估 1.74 倍。逐项拆开更有意思——①底数：账 2 用的 Madey 低增益公式假设「场在一程内不变」，而本机 Z̄=1.98 已是 3.4 个功率增益长度、一程内场强涨 4.5 倍 → **Madey 低估 1.67 倍**；②滑移折减：账 2 的工程估计 1/(1+Nλ/lb)=0.600 真值 0.604，**准到 0.7%**；③能散折减 0.715 vs 0.730，差 2.1%；④三项相乘与直接模拟的可乘性误差 **0.0%**。**我在账 2 里点名说「滑移折减是全册最弱的一环」，结果它最准；错的是我以为最稳的那一环——教科书公式的适用域。它不长得像假设，所以最容易漏检。**

账 9 失谐曲线（振荡器的身份曲线，账 2 里完全没有）：以 L_synch = c·T_b/2 + Nλ/2（完全补偿滑移）为参考，可激射区间是缩短 **41–147 µm**（106 µm 宽），最佳点 δL = 41 µm，功率 −10% 窗口 35 µm。**但真正的发现是：腔长失谐不是一个公差，是一个用户旋钮**—— 在这 106 µm 里脉宽从 3.07 变到 4.07 ps、谱宽 Δλ/λ 从 0.90% 变到 0.45%、功率变 31 倍（更细的扫描步长下这三个跨度还会再拉开）。短脉冲/宽谱档给光束线 2（泵浦-探测），长脉冲/窄谱档给光束线 1（高分辨光谱）—— **同一台机器拧一个旋钮切换两种运行模式**。谱宽复现到 ±10% 需腔长控制 **±9 µm**（灵敏度 0.0063 %/µm）；功率口径 ±18 µm。

账 9 取出率二维扫描（T 与失谐不独立，必须一起扫）：最优不在账 2 给的 0.348，而在 **T ≈ 0.10–0.20**。原因是低取出率让腔内场更强、饱和更深，电子交出的能量反而多（模型给抽取效率 3.7 ρ_eff）。定版取 **T = 0.20 @ δL = 15 µm**：输出 **46 µJ/微脉冲**、建立 112 圈（4.5 µs）、饱和占空 78%；25 MHz 模式平均 178 mW、1 GHz 模式（修法②）约 2.5 W。**诚实划界**：模型的 T=0.10 最优点给 82 µJ，已高出 FELIX 实测口径（1–50 µJ），一维模型缺横模竞争与增益导引，抽取效率系统性偏高 —— 故定版取更保守的 T=0.20，把 T=0.10 留给三维验证之后再说。

账 9 四道闸门：**D1** 低增益极限（Z̄=0.4）复现解析 Madey，幅度比 1.042、线型偏差 4.6% PASS；**D2** 高增益极限（Z̄=6）复现一维指数渐近 exp(√3Z̄)/9，比值 1.012 PASS；**F** 本机 Z̄=1.98 恰在两极限之间的过渡区——这正是必须上时变数值解的理由；**E** 能量守恒最大偏差 4.3% **FAIL**，诚实归因：不是物理不守恒，是场更新用了一阶欧拉（40 步/程）的离散误差，量级与步长同阶，且小于模型本身缺横向自由度带来的 5–15%。

账 10 腔光学定版：对称近共心腔，镜曲率半径 **R = 3.188 m**、g = −0.882、g₁g₂ = 0.778，两个曲率中心只隔 376 mm。代价是镜倾被放大 **8.5 倍**变成光轴倾角 → 由「波荡器内光轴走离 ≤ w₀/10」反推得 5 µm 端公差 9.9 µrad，定版 **α_rms ≤ 5 µrad**（2× 裕度）。镜面 ⌀100 mm 在全波段给 a/w ≥ 2，截断损耗可忽略。金膜 Drude 计算给 R = 0.995 且在 30:1 带宽上几乎是常数（往返损耗 1.00%→0.72%）—— 账 2 拍的「双镜 1%」是对的，现在有了理由；5 µm 端因带间跃迁按 2% 记更稳妥。

账 10 镜面热与损伤：腔内平均功率仅 2.5 W（占空比 2e-4 的功劳），单镜吸收 12 mW，一路 0.5 L/min 水冷足够；脉冲通量 0.012 mJ/cm² 对金膜皮秒损伤阈 0.1–0.3 J/cm² **裕度四个量级**。**镜面是本机最省心的光学件**，这与地球上高平均功率 FEL（镜面热畸变是头号难题）恰好相反。取出孔径轮按账 9 的新取出率重算：**⌀2/5/8/10/11 mm** 五档。

账 14（轴对称三维时变振荡器，第三轮新增）：QDHT 傍轴衍射 + 真实腔往返 + 增益导引自洽，全 SI 单位。五道闸门——G0 自由传播复现 w(z) 到 0.01%、G0b 镜相位符号自检、G1 冷腔本征模 10 圈自重叠 0.9989、G2 均匀无衍射极限复现 Madey 到 5.2%、**E3 能量逐项闭合 0.66% PASS**（账 9 的一维版是 4.3% FAIL——三维版反而更干净，因为源项按 Galerkin 构造保证了逐项守恒）。核心真数：**三维小信号超模增益 1.068 = 一维 1.53 的 0.70 倍**——账 9 局限声明里拍的「5–15%」低估了一倍，模式失配+衍射逃逸实际吃掉 30%。

账 14 的头号发现（第三轮最重要的一条自我修正）：**取出孔在本波段全程处于衍射区**（N_F = a²/λL ≈ 0.036 ≪ 1），账 10c 的面积公式 T = 1−exp(−2a²/w²) 默认几何遮挡区，在这里不成立。三维实测：孔既直接取光、又以锐边衍射陪葬（Xie 比值 0.6–0.7）、还压低带孔超模增益（1.07 → 0.90/0.81/0.70 @ T名义 0.05/0.10/0.15）。**第二轮当「保守」定版的 T=0.20 在三维里净增益只剩 1.005/圈，实质不激射——保守的方向搞反了：衍射区里大孔不是稳妥而是自杀。**三维定版 **T名义 = 0.10**（20 µm 处孔 ⌀4.1 mm）：输出 48.9 µJ/微脉冲、腔内 396 µJ、抽取 1.37%、已收敛。孔径轮随之改义：不再是「同波长换取出率」，而是**定 T≈0.10、按波长换档**（⌀2.1/4.1/6.5/9.2/11.3 mm ↔ 5/20/50/100/150 µm；a∝√λ 使 N_F 不变，五档同一套物理）。要更高取出率的出路是刮刀镜/布儒斯特板，记入升级路线。

账 14 的第二个惊讶：三维输出 48.9 µJ 与一维的 46 µJ **几乎重合——但这是两个反向修正的巧合**。三维增益低 30%（模式失配+衍射逃逸），抽取效率却高 1.3 倍（增益导引把光场压在电子束上，束上局部场强超过模式平均，饱和更深）。两者相抵，用户功率量级（178 mW @25 MHz / ~2.5 W @1 GHz）**站得住**，但依据已从一维换成三维。巧合写明是巧合——它不是模型互证，是误差对消。

账 17（第五轮）：把账 15 的真束流（20 A / σδ 0.02%，取代四轮沿用的「50 A/0.3%」假设）灌回两台已验证的振荡器码，功率口径定稿。回归闸门 R1：复刻的一维核心在旧参数复现 1.53（偏差 0.3%）。真束流结果：一维超模增益 0.675（Z̄ 缩 0.74× 被冷束红利补一部分），**三维 0.721——与一维持平**（50 A 时三维罚 30%，冷束低增益点上增益导引把罚金抵平，这是第五轮最好的消息）。三维饱和（T=0.10）：**5.4 µJ/微脉冲**、建立 222 圈（8.9 µs，吃掉宏脉冲 44%）、饱和占空 56%。**定稿功率表：15 mW @25 MHz / 121 mW @200 MHz**。口径演变全程留痕：账 2 解析 21 mW → 账 9 一维 178 mW → 账 14 三维 48.9 µJ（巧合重合）→ 账 17 真束流 **15 mW/0.12 W**——四轮账把数字磨真，每一步都知道自己为什么变。顺带一条数值坑（第 22 条）：失谐以 l_c 为单位而 l_c 随 ρ_eff 变，跨工作点复用「-1.90 l_c」直接跑出激射带（首跑 G=-0.05），单位随参数漂移的常数必须换算后迁移。

账 19 定稿、账 20 修订的全波段功率表（真束流，口径逐行分级）：10 µm 6.5 µJ/18 mW@25MHz（三维@38.1 MeV，T=0.05，账 20）· 20 µm 5.4 µJ/15 mW（三维，账 17）· 50 µm 11.5 µJ/41 mW（一维，账 17 证冷束点 3D≈1D）· 150 µm 6.1 µJ/23 mW（2.5D，账 24 上调）。200 MHz 模式（修法④）对应 146/120/331/175 mW。第七轮的 6.5 µm 行随 50 MeV 一起作废；各末能束团口径由账 20B 背书（18–27 A、σδ ≤0.03%）。（账 21 顶格微调 38.1→37.0 MeV，账 22 三维定稿：**10 µm = 5.91 µJ / 16.2 mW@25MHz / 129 mW@200MHz**，建立 9.0 µs；边界与波段口径不动）

账 19 的回归侦探课：v1 输出 12.1 µJ vs 账 17 锚 16.0——仲裁脚本跑 500 圈证明锚是对的（ds=−1.40 处稳态 16.0），真凶是腔内失谐微扫步长 0.3 l_c 跨过了失谐峰（峰在 −1.41，扫描从 −1.31 跳 −1.61）。失谐曲线的陡度（功率口径 ±18 µm ≈ 0.07 l_c）账 9 自己早就量过——扫描网格必须先对照自己账本里量过的特征尺度。步长加密到 0.1 l_c 后全表输出都涨了（50 µm 8.6→11.5、150 µm 4.6→5.9 µJ）：失谐峰没踩准时，整张功率表都在把功率留在地上。

账 22 播种账（账 21 关死宏脉冲拉长后唯一的建立期旋钮）：建立期对数律成账（闸门 K1：实测斜率 vs −1/ln(1+g_净) 偏差 1%）——省圈 = ln(种子/噪声)/ln(1+g_净)。外部种子经取出孔反向注入（孔透 5% × 模式重叠 60%）：10.6 µm CO₂ 激光 1–10 W 货架源与 10 µm 边界点近重合是白捡的运气，三维口径建立 9.0 → 4.0 µs、**平均功率 ×1.46**（16.2 → 23.6 mW@25MHz）；QCL 盖 13–20 µm（×1.13–1.24）；长波端建立本来快、源又弱，不值得。噪声底取「三维 1 V/m ≈ 一维 1e-6」互证锚（账 17 两码建立期 221 vs 222 圈），自发辐射入模严格账标为局限（噪声底差 ±10× 建立期只差 ±1.4 µs，结论不动）。
sim_en: Ledger 2 gate A (known answer): the Ming Xie 3D fit applied to LCLS (13.6 GeV, 1.5 A, 3.4 kA, 0.4 um normalised emittance) gives rho = 4.83e-4, 1D gain length 2.853 m, correction 0.188 and a 3D gain length of 3.39 m - 2.7% above the published 3.3 m. PASS. Saturation at 20 gain lengths is 68 m, matching the 60-80 m of undulator LCLS actually uses.

Ledger 2 gates B and B2: numerical integration of the 1D pendulum equations reproduces the third-order perturbative Madey lineshape -d/dnu[sinc^2(nu/2)] with the peak at nu = 2.60 (analytic 2.606) and 0.08% deviation across the whole curve; feeding real physical constants through the pendulum end-to-end gives a single-pass gain whose ratio to the analytic Madey formula is 1.0000. This also settles a common convention trap: the peak coefficient in the nu variable is 0.27008, and the 0.5403 often quoted is the derivative with respect to nu/2.

Ledger 2 reductions: energy spread 0.715 x slippage 0.60 (at 20 um) x angular spread 0.98 gives 88% single-pass gain. The angular-spread factor stays above 0.97 everywhere - that is precisely what choosing the infrared buys.

Ledger 2, outcoupling optimisation (objective = coupling x saturated duration): stretching the macropulse from 10 to 20 us raises the saturated duty from about 40% to about 70% and multiplies output energy by 2.4, so 20 us is the baseline. It also proves the outcoupler must be swappable: the optimum differs by 2x between 5 um and 20 um.

Ledger 6, cavity length: integrating the colony isolation line of 1.2e-6 m/s/sqrt(Hz) at 10 m gives 190 nm rms floor displacement over 1-100 Hz. Two mirrors anchored independently 6 m apart move differentially by 119 nm - a margin of 0.8x on the 0.1 um narrow-band spec, i.e. none at all. Putting both on one Invar bench (first mode 80 Hz, Q 20) cuts that to 24 nm. The colony isolation line is not enough by itself; the fix is common-moding, not a tighter line.

Ledger 9 (new: time-dependent 1D oscillator) overturns ledger 2's gain. The self-consistent multi-slice solution with slippage and cavity feedback gives a supermode gain of 1.53 per pass, so ledger 2's 0.88 was 1.74x low. The breakdown is the interesting part: (1) the base - ledger 2 used the low-gain Madey formula, which assumes the field is constant through one pass, whereas at Z-bar = 1.98 this machine is already 3.4 power gain lengths long and the field triples within a pass, so Madey underestimates by 1.67x; (2) the slippage factor - ledger 2's engineering guess 1/(1+N*lambda/lb) = 0.600 against a true 0.604, accurate to 0.7%; (3) energy spread 0.715 against 0.730, off by 2.1%; (4) multiplying the three factors matches the direct simulation to 0.0%. The link I singled out as the weakest turned out to be the most accurate; what failed was the textbook formula's domain of validity - the assumption that does not look like an assumption.

Ledger 9's detuning curve - the oscillator's signature, entirely absent from ledger 2. Referenced to L_synch = c*T_b/2 + N*lambda/2 (full slippage compensation), lasing spans a 106 um range of cavity shortening (41-147 um), peaking at 41 um, with the power staying within 10% of peak over 35 um. The real finding is that cavity detuning is not a tolerance but a user knob: across that range the pulse length goes from 3.07 to 4.07 ps, the spectral width from 0.90% to 0.45% and the power by 31x (a finer scan widens all three). The short-pulse, broad-spectrum setting serves beamline 2 (pump-probe); the long-pulse, narrow-spectrum setting serves beamline 1 (high-resolution spectroscopy) - one knob, two machines. Reproducing the spectral width to 10% needs +/-9 um (sensitivity 0.0063 %/um); the power criterion is +/-18 um.

Ledger 9's two-dimensional outcoupling scan (T and detuning are not independent and must be scanned together) puts the optimum not at ledger 2's 0.348 but at T = 0.10-0.20. Lower outcoupling lets the intracavity field grow stronger and saturate deeper, so the electrons actually give up more energy - the model predicts an extraction efficiency of 3.7 rho_eff. The baseline is set at T = 0.20 with 15 um detuning: 46 uJ per micropulse, 112 round trips (4.5 us) to build up, 78% saturated duty; 178 mW average in 25 MHz mode and about 2.5 W in the 1 GHz mode. Honest boundary: the model's T = 0.10 optimum would give 82 uJ, above the measured FELIX range of 1-50 uJ, and a 1D model without transverse mode competition or gain guiding systematically overestimates extraction - hence the more conservative baseline, with T = 0.10 left for a 3D check.

Ledger 9's four gates: D1, the low-gain limit (Z-bar = 0.4) reproduces the analytic Madey result with amplitude ratio 1.042 and 4.6% lineshape deviation - PASS; D2, the high-gain limit (Z-bar = 6) reproduces the 1D exponential asymptote exp(sqrt(3)Z)/9 with ratio 1.012 - PASS; F shows this machine at Z-bar = 1.98 sits in the crossover between the two limits, which is exactly why a time-dependent numerical solution was required; E, energy conservation, deviates by up to 4.3% and FAILS - honestly attributed not to broken physics but to the first-order Euler field update at 40 steps per pass, an error of the same order as the step size and smaller than the 5-15% from the model's missing transverse degrees of freedom.

Ledger 10 fixes the resonator: a symmetric near-concentric cavity with mirror radius 3.188 m, g = -0.882, g1g2 = 0.778, the two centres of curvature only 376 mm apart. The price is that mirror tilt is amplified 8.5x into optical-axis tilt; requiring the axis to wander less than w0/10 inside the undulator gives a 9.9 urad tolerance at 5 um, so the spec is 5 urad rms with 2x margin. The 100 mm mirrors give a/w >= 2 across the whole band, so edge clipping is negligible. A Drude calculation gives gold R = 0.995, almost constant across the 30:1 band (round-trip loss 1.00% falling to 0.72%), which vindicates ledger 2's flat 1% assumption - now with a reason; at 5 um interband absorption makes 2% the safer number.

Ledger 10 on mirror heat and damage: average intracavity power is only 2.5 W (thanks to the 2e-4 duty cycle), each mirror absorbs 12 mW, and one 0.5 L/min water circuit suffices; the pulse fluence of 0.012 mJ/cm2 sits four orders of magnitude below gold's 0.1-0.3 J/cm2 picosecond damage threshold. The mirrors are the most trouble-free optics on this machine - the opposite of high-average-power FELs on Earth, where mirror thermal distortion is the number one problem. The outcoupling aperture wheel was resized to ledger 9's new coupling values: five holes of 2, 5, 8, 10 and 11 mm.

Ledger 14 (round three): an axisymmetric time-dependent 3D oscillator - QDHT paraxial diffraction, the real cavity round trip and self-consistent gain guiding, all in SI units. Five gates: free-space propagation reproduces w(z) to 0.01%; the mirror-phase sign self-test; the cold-cavity eigenmode self-overlaps at 0.9989 over ten round trips; the uniform no-diffraction limit reproduces Madey to 5.2%; and energy closure at 0.66% PASSES - where the 1D code failed at 4.3%, the 3D version is cleaner because its Galerkin source term conserves energy by construction. The core number: the 3D small-signal supermode gain is 1.068, i.e. 0.70 of the 1D 1.53 - the '5-15%' guessed in ledger 9's limitations understated the mode-mismatch and diffraction losses by half; they actually cost 30%.

Ledger 14's chief finding, and the round's most important self-correction: the outcoupling hole operates entirely in the diffractive regime (Fresnel number a^2/lambda*L about 0.036), where ledger 10c's area formula - valid only for geometric shadowing - does not hold. In 3D the hole extracts light, wastes a comparable amount to sharp-edge diffraction (Xie ratio 0.6-0.7), and depresses the with-hole supermode gain from 1.07 to 0.90/0.81/0.70 at nominal T of 0.05/0.10/0.15. The T = 0.20 that round two adopted as 'conservative' retains a net gain of only 1.005 per round trip in 3D - effectively no lasing. Conservatism pointed the wrong way: in the diffractive regime a big hole is not safe but fatal. The 3D baseline is nominal T = 0.10 (a 4.1 mm hole at 20 um): 48.9 uJ out per micropulse, 396 uJ intracavity, 1.37% extraction, converged. The aperture wheel changes meaning accordingly: no longer 'different couplings at one wavelength' but fixed T of about 0.10 with one hole per wavelength - 2.1/4.1/6.5/9.2/11.3 mm for 5/20/50/100/150 um; since a scales as sqrt(lambda) the Fresnel number is invariant and all five stops share one physics. The route to higher coupling is a scraper mirror or Brewster plate, filed under upgrades.

Ledger 14's second surprise: the 3D output of 48.9 uJ nearly coincides with the 1D 46 uJ - but this is a coincidence of two opposing corrections. The 3D gain is 30% lower (mode mismatch and diffraction escape) while the extraction efficiency is 1.3 times higher, because gain guiding concentrates the field onto the electron beam, where the local intensity exceeds the mode average and saturation runs deeper. The two cancel, so the user power figures (178 mW at 25 MHz, about 2.5 W at 1 GHz) stand - now on a 3D footing. It is recorded as a coincidence, not mutual validation: errors cancelling is not agreement.

Ledger 17 (round five): the true beam from ledger 15 (20 A, 0.02% slice spread, replacing the '50 A / 0.3%' assumption carried through four rounds) is fed back into both validated oscillator codes to finalise the power figures. Regression gate R1: the re-implemented 1D core reproduces 1.53 at the old parameters to 0.3%. True-beam results: 1D supermode gain 0.675 (the shrunken Z-bar partly repaid by the cold-beam dividend), and 3D gain 0.721 - level with 1D. At 50 A the 3D penalty was 30%; at the cold low-current point gain guiding cancels it, the round's best news. 3D saturation at T = 0.10: 5.4 uJ per micropulse, 222 round trips (8.9 us, 44% of the macropulse) to build up, 56% saturated duty. Final power table: 15 mW at 25 MHz, 121 mW at 200 MHz. The full audit trail of the figure: 21 mW analytic (L2), 178 mW 1D (L9), 48.9 uJ 3D coincidence (L14), 15 mW / 0.12 W true beam (L17) - four rounds grinding the number true, each step knowing why it moved. One new numerical pit (no. 22): detunings quoted in cooperation lengths do not survive a change of working point, since l_c moves with rho_eff - reusing '-1.90 l_c' across operating points ran straight out of the lasing band.

Full-band power table, set by ledger 19 and revised by ledger 20 (true beam, per-row honesty labels): 10 um 6.5 uJ / 18 mW @25 MHz (3D at 38.1 MeV, T=0.05, ledger 20); 20 um 5.4 uJ / 15 mW (3D, ledger 17); 50 um 11.5 uJ / 41 mW (1D - ledger 17 showed 3D~1D at the cold point); 150 um 6.1 uJ / 23 mW (2.5D, raised by ledger 24). The 200 MHz mode (fix 4) gives 146/120/331/175 mW. Round 7's 6.5 um row died with the 50 MeV it stood on; the per-energy bunch parameters are now backed by ledger 20B (18-27 A, spread <=0.03%). (Ledger 21 trims the ceiling to 37.0 MeV; ledger 22 signs off the 10 um 3D point: 5.91 uJ / 16.2 mW @25 MHz / 129 mW @200 MHz, 9.0 us build-up. Boundary and band unchanged.)

Ledger 19's regression detective story: v1 output read 12.1 uJ against ledger 17's 16.0 anchor. A 500-round-trip arbitration run proved the anchor right (16.0 uJ is the stable state at ds = -1.40); the culprit was the cavity detuning micro-scan whose 0.3 l_c step jumped clean over the detuning peak at -1.41. The steepness of that curve (+-18 um ~ 0.07 l_c power tolerance) was measured back in ledger 9 - a scan grid must respect the feature scales in your own books. With 0.1 l_c steps every wavelength gained output (50 um 8.6 to 11.5, 150 um 4.6 to 5.9 uJ): miss the detuning peak and the whole power table leaves energy on the floor.

Ledger 22, the seeding account - the only build-up knob left after ledger 21 closed macropulse stretching: the build-up logarithm law is now a gated result (gate K1: measured slope matches -1/ln(1+net gain) to 1%), so circles saved = ln(seed/noise)/ln(1+g). An external seed injected backwards through the outcoupling hole (5% hole transmission x 60% mode overlap): the 10.6 um CO2 laser line - a 1-10 W shelf source - landing next to the 10 um boundary point is free luck. In the 3D accounting the build-up drops 9.0 to 4.0 us and average power gains x1.46 (16.2 to 23.6 mW @25 MHz); QCLs cover 13-20 um (x1.13-1.24); the long-wave end builds fast anyway and its sources are weak - not worth it. The noise floor is anchored by the cross-validated '3D 1 V/m ~ 1D 1e-6' seed (221 vs 222 round trips in ledger 17); the rigorous spontaneous-emission-into-mode account is a stated limitation (+-10x moves build-up by only +-1.4 us).
physics: **为什么红外用腔、X 射线只能 SASE**：把同一把尺子放到两台机器上——LCLS 束流配 2.6 m 波荡器单程增益 8%，本机 20 µm 处 88%。增益不是分水岭。分水岭是三件东西：(1) 镜子——1.5 Å 上任何材料正入射反射率 ~1e-5，Bragg 晶体腔只在固定波长/角度上有 R~0.9 且带宽 ~10 meV，那是一台单色机器不是可调用户装置；(2) 重频——腔长 L 要求微脉冲间隔 = 2L/c，本机 6 m → 25 MHz，L 波段常温机天然给得出，而 X 射线铜直线加速器 120 Hz，腔里等不到下一团；(3) 于是 X 射线只能单程 SASE，从噪声长到饱和要 ~68 m 波荡器。
本机若走 SASE 也要 20×1.48 = 30 m 波荡器 —— 城里放不下。谐振腔把这段路拆成 2.6 m × 112 次往返 = 等效 292 m 相互作用长度，硬件成本差两个量级。这就是红外 FEL 用腔的全部理由。
Pierce 参数 ρ 同时是三件事：增益长度的倒数尺度（Lg = λu/4π√3ρ）、饱和效率（P_sat ≈ ρP_beam）、能散容限（σ_δ ≲ ρ）。本机 ρ = 0.9–2.6%，比 X 射线 FEL 的 5e-4 大 20–50 倍 —— 短波贵，贵在这里。
physics_en: Why the infrared uses a resonator and X-rays cannot: measured with the same ruler, LCLS's beam in a 2.6 m undulator gives 8% single-pass gain and this machine gives 88% at 20 um. Gain is not the divide. Three other things are: (1) mirrors - at 1.5 A no material has more than about 1e-5 normal-incidence reflectivity, and a Bragg crystal cavity works only at one fixed wavelength and angle with roughly 10 meV bandwidth, which is a monochromatic machine, not a tunable user facility; (2) repetition rate - a cavity of length L demands a micropulse spacing of 2L/c, which an L-band warm linac supplies naturally at 25 MHz while an X-ray copper linac runs at 120 Hz and the cavity never sees the next bunch; (3) hence X-rays must go single-pass SASE, needing about 68 m of undulator to grow from noise to saturation.

This machine on the SASE route would need 20 x 1.48 = 30 m of undulator, which will not fit underground. The resonator splits that path into 2.6 m x 112 round trips, an equivalent interaction length of 292 m, at two orders of magnitude less hardware.

The Pierce parameter rho is three things at once: the inverse scale of the gain length, the saturation efficiency (P_sat about rho times beam power), and the energy-spread tolerance. Here rho is 0.9-2.6%, some 20-50 times the 5e-4 of an X-ray FEL - that is where the cost of short wavelengths lives.

pois.label: 束流 dump 与屏蔽墙（含光中子与 ⁴¹Ar 账）
pois.label_en: Beam Dump and Shield Wall (photoneutrons and Ar-41)
pois.detail: 电子束在波荡器后被两只 45° 偶极折 90°，穿过 2.0 m 重混凝土墙上的一只贯穿孔进入 dump 洞。dump 本体做成 3/4 剖切，五层同色因果链一眼读完：铝芯 1.0 m（11 X0，吃掉簇射主体、光中子最少）→ 钢 20 cm → 铅 10 cm（收硬光子尾巴）→ 含硼聚乙烯 15 cm（热中子）→ 重混凝土 2.0 m。地面红区、四只互锁红灯与安全橙护栏定义禁入范围。
pois.detail_en: After the undulator the electron beam is turned through 90 degrees by two 45-degree dipoles and enters the dump vault through a penetration in a 2.0 m heavy-concrete wall. The dump itself is shown as a three-quarter cutaway whose five layers form a single colour-coded chain: a 1.0 m aluminium core (11 radiation lengths, absorbing the shower with the fewest photoneutrons), 20 cm of steel, 10 cm of lead to catch the hard photon tail, 15 cm of borated polyethylene for thermal neutrons, and 2.0 m of heavy concrete. A painted red zone, four interlocked red lamps and safety-orange railing define the exclusion area.

specs.束流功率: 平均 420 W（1 GHz 模式），设计取 500 W；宏脉冲峰值 2.0 MW × 21 µs = 42 J/发
specs.dump 结构: Al 1.0 m + Fe 20 cm + Pb 10 cm + 含硼 PE 15 cm + 重混凝土 2.0 m（ρ=3.5）
specs.屏蔽目标: 屏蔽体外走廊（距 dump 8 m）≤ 0.5 µSv/h
specs.地表方向: 30 m 玄武岩 = 82 个十倍层，衰减 1e-82
specs.单发温升: 4.8 mK（簇射峰区 2.9 kg 铝），一路 3 L/min 冷却水足够
specs.Geant4 签核（账 18）: 中子产额 ×3.6（Fe/Pb 尾巴漏记）· TVL 实测 32.7 cm（+8%）· 裕度 77×→25× 仍闭合

specs_en.Beam power: 420 W average in 1 GHz mode (500 W design); macropulse peak 2.0 MW x 21 us = 42 J per shot
specs_en.Dump stack: 1.0 m Al + 20 cm Fe + 10 cm Pb + 15 cm borated PE + 2.0 m heavy concrete (3.5 g/cm3)
specs_en.Shielding target: 0.5 uSv/h in the aisle, 8 m from the dump
specs_en.Shielding delivered: 11.95 photon TVLs against 10.06 required (77x margin); 12.32 neutron TVLs against 4.52
specs_en.Toward the surface: 30 m of basalt is 82 TVLs, an attenuation of 1e-82
specs_en.Per-shot temperature rise: 4.8 mK in the 2.9 kg shower-peak region; one 3 L/min water circuit suffices
specs_en.Geant4 sign-off (L18): Neutron yield 3.6x (the Fe/Pb tail was unbooked); measured TVL 32.7 cm (+8%); margin 77x to 25x, still closed

sim: 账 5 必须直面的一条：光中子阈值。²⁷Al 13.06 MeV、⁶³Cu 10.85、¹⁶O 15.67、¹²C 18.72 —— **20 MeV 低能模式就已越过全部结构材料阈值**，50 MeV 处巨偶极共振（峰 20–23 MeV）完全激发。医用直线加速器 ≤10 MV 不做中子屏蔽的惯例在本机上完全不适用；选 20–50 MeV = 自愿进入光中子区。
账 5 选材：巨偶极求和规则 σ_int ∝ NZ/A → 铝的光中子产额只有钨的 1/6.6（1.83e11 vs 1.2e12 n/(s·kW)），代价是 dump 长 25 倍。定版铝芯 + 高 Z 短尾巴。
账 5 反直觉结论：**光子定尺寸，中子白送**。厚靶轫致辐射前向峰化因子 2267×各向同性，把 0° 方向 1 m 处剂量率推到 3e5 Gy/h（对比 6 MV 医用机无均整器折算约 2e6 Gy/h/kW，同量级自洽）；中子近各向同性，只有 1.05 Sv/h。需求相差 5.5 个十倍层。

账 5 火星特有账 ⁴¹Ar：城市缓冲气从火星大气提取（N₂:Ar = 1.34:1），洞室 Ar 分压 21.1 kPa = **地球空气的 23 倍**。8 h 束流后 ⁴¹Ar 浓度 140 Bq/m³，只占职业 DAC 的 0.13% —— 人员剂量不是问题。真正定架构的是 sci-deeplab-01：⁴¹Ar 发 1.29 MeV γ，未衰变的洞室空气（1.9e6 Bq）若直接串进深地气路，相当于把那里岩壁 γ 源强（~1e7 Bq）抬高 18%。**排风隔离 + ≥12 h 滞留衰变（×0.011）是硬要求，且它是被暗物质实验的本底要求定下来的，不是被人员剂量定下来的。**这是两台装置真实的耦合面。
地球上排空就完事；火星上 13,440 m³ 含 43% 氩的缓冲气是战略物资，不能排 —— 所以只能滞留衰变。短寿命同伴 ¹⁵O(2 min)/¹³N(10 min)/¹¹C(20 min) 被同一条规则一并解决。

账 18（第六轮）：**Geant4 签核落地**（11.2.2，城内 Ubuntu VM 自跑：FTFP_BERT + 光核反应，4e6 个 50 MeV e⁻ 全几何 + 6e5×2 光子束 TVL 专项）。方法分工明确：MC 校准解析账里带 ±3× 不确定度的三个承重数字，12 层的乘法仍归解析——屏蔽工程标准做法。三闸门：**S1 FAIL（诚实保留）**——dump 光中子产额 5.29e-3 n/e⁻ = 账 5 折算的 **3.6 倍**，蒸发谱均能 2.25 MeV 确认物理对；归因是签核最值钱的一句：账 5 按纯铝折算，**漏掉的不是物理系数而是自己设计的几何**——收硬光子尾巴的 Fe/Pb 两层（阈值 10.9/7.4 MeV低于铝的 13.1）同时是光中子工厂。**S2 PASS**——重混凝土宽束 TVL 实测 32.7 cm（R²=0.9994）vs 账 5 取的 30.2 cm（+8%），恰落在窄束理论 28.5 与宽束修正之间 = 合理保守。**S3 PASS**——墙深 0.8 m 后中子计数为零、光子独占（「光子定尺寸中子白送」在 MC 里直接成立）。

账 18 回填后的屏蔽收支：中子源强 ×3.6 → 需求 4.52→5.08 十倍层，**仍远小于光子的 10.06 → 墙厚不改**；光子层数按实测 TVL 重算 2.0 m 墙 = 6.12 层（原记 6.62），总供给 11.45 vs 需求 10.06 → **裕度 77× 收敛到 25×，仍闭合**；⁴¹Ar 活化同倍放大 140→504 Bq/m³（DAC 的 0.5%，人员口径依旧宽），深地气路耦合 18%→65% → **≥12 h 滞留衰变的地位从「硬要求」升为「更硬」**（×0.011 后余 0.7%，仍闭合）——MC 把每一项裕度都压小了，但没有一项翻转。这就是 L4 签核应有的样子：数字动，结论稳。
sim_en: Ledger 5, the thing that must be faced: photoneutron thresholds. Al-27 at 13.06 MeV, Cu-63 at 10.85, O-16 at 15.67, C-12 at 18.72 - even the 20 MeV low-energy mode is above every structural material, and at 50 MeV the giant dipole resonance (peaking at 20-23 MeV) is fully excited. The medical-linac convention of skipping neutron shielding below 10 MV simply does not apply; choosing 20-50 MeV means voluntarily entering photoneutron territory.

Ledger 5, material choice: the dipole sum rule makes the integrated cross-section scale as NZ/A, so aluminium yields 6.6x fewer photoneutrons than tungsten (1.83e11 against 1.2e12 n/s/kW), at the price of a dump 25 times longer. Baseline: aluminium core with a short high-Z tail.

Ledger 5, the counterintuitive result: photons set the thickness and the neutron shield comes free. Thick-target bremsstrahlung is forward-peaked by a factor of 2267 over isotropic, pushing the on-axis dose rate at 1 m to 3e5 Gy/h (consistent with the roughly 2e6 Gy/h/kW of an unflattened 6 MV medical linac), whereas the near-isotropic neutrons give only 1.05 Sv/h. The two requirements differ by 5.5 decades.

Ledger 5, a Mars-specific ledger - Ar-41: the colony's buffer gas is extracted from the Martian atmosphere (N2:Ar = 1.34:1), so the hall's argon partial pressure is 21.1 kPa, 23 times Earth air. After 8 h of beam the Ar-41 concentration reaches 140 Bq/m3, only 0.13% of the occupational DAC - personnel dose is not the issue. What sets the architecture is sci-deeplab-01: Ar-41 emits a 1.29 MeV gamma, and undecayed hall air (1.9e6 Bq) fed straight into the deep-lab air path would raise that cavern's rock-gamma source term (about 1e7 Bq) by 18%. Exhaust isolation plus a 12 h decay hold (x0.011) is therefore a hard requirement - set by the dark-matter experiment's background budget, not by personnel dose, which has 600x margin. That is the real coupling between the two facilities.

On Earth you would simply purge. On Mars, 13,440 m3 of buffer gas that is 43% argon is a strategic resource that cannot be vented, so decay hold is the only option. The short-lived companions O-15 (2 min), N-13 (10 min) and C-11 (20 min) are handled by the same rule.

Ledger 18 (round six): the Geant4 sign-off lands - 11.2.2 on the colony's Ubuntu VM, FTFP_BERT with photonuclear physics, 4e6 electrons at 50 MeV through the full geometry plus two dedicated 6e5-photon TVL runs. The division of labour is explicit: Monte Carlo calibrates the three load-bearing numbers that carried a stated 3x uncertainty, while the twelve-layer multiplication stays analytic - standard shielding practice. Three gates: S1 FAILS and is kept - the dump photoneutron yield of 5.29e-3 n per electron is 3.6x the ledger's scaling, with the 2.25 MeV evaporation-spectrum mean confirming the physics; the attribution is the sign-off's most valuable sentence: the ledger scaled for pure aluminium, and what it missed was not a physics coefficient but its own design - the Fe and Pb layers that catch the hard photon tail are themselves photoneutron factories, with thresholds at 10.9 and 7.4 MeV, below aluminium's 13.1. S2 PASSES: the measured broad-beam TVL of heavy concrete is 32.7 cm (R^2 = 0.9994) against the assumed 30.2 cm (+8%), sitting between narrow-beam theory at 28.5 cm and the build-up corrected value - conservatively placed. S3 PASSES: beyond 0.8 m of wall the neutron count is zero and photons own the problem - 'photons size the wall, neutrons ride free' holds directly in the Monte Carlo.

The shielding balance after ledger 18's feedback: the neutron source term rises 3.6x, pushing the requirement from 4.52 to 5.08 decades - still far below the photons' 10.06, so the wall thickness stands. Recomputing the photon stack with the measured TVL gives the 2.0 m wall 6.12 decades (booked as 6.62), total supply 11.45 against a need of 10.06 - the margin tightens from 77x to 25x and still closes. Ar-41 activation scales by the same factor, 140 to 504 Bq/m3 (0.5% of the occupational limit), and the deep-lab air-path coupling grows from 18% to 65%, promoting the 12-hour decay hold from 'hard requirement' to 'harder' (0.7% residual after the hold - still closed). The Monte Carlo shrank every margin and overturned nothing: exactly what an L4 sign-off should look like.
physics: 电子撞厚靶时，轫致辐射带走 Y = ZE/(ZE+800) 的能量（铝在 50 MeV 是 45%），并被相对论效应压进 ~1/E 的前向锥里 —— 这就是那 2267 倍峰化因子的来源，也是为什么 dump 的正前方比侧面危险三个量级。
光中子来自巨偶极共振：~20 MeV 的光子把整个原子核的质子层与中子层相对振荡起来，然后蒸发出一颗 ~2 MeV 的中子。阈值就是把一颗中子从核里拽出来的结合能，所以低 Z 轻核阈值高、重核阈值低。
⁴⁰Ar(n,γ)⁴¹Ar 的热中子截面只有 0.66 b，比 ¹⁴N(n,p) 的 1.83 b 还小；⁴¹Ar 之所以成为主角，纯粹是因为火星缓冲气里氩多 —— 同一台机器搬到地球，这条账小 23 倍，就不会定架构。
physics_en: When electrons hit a thick target, bremsstrahlung carries away a fraction Y = ZE/(ZE+800) of the energy - 45% for aluminium at 50 MeV - and relativity squeezes it into a forward cone of order 1/E. That is where the 2267x peaking factor comes from, and why straight ahead of a dump is three orders of magnitude more dangerous than beside it.

Photoneutrons come from the giant dipole resonance: a roughly 20 MeV photon sets the nucleus's proton and neutron fluids oscillating against each other, after which a roughly 2 MeV neutron evaporates. The threshold is the binding energy of that neutron, which is why light nuclei have high thresholds and heavy nuclei low ones.

The thermal cross-section of Ar-40(n,gamma)Ar-41 is only 0.66 b, smaller than the 1.83 b of N-14(n,p). Ar-41 dominates here purely because Martian buffer gas is argon-rich; the same machine on Earth would see this ledger 23 times smaller and it would not drive the architecture.

The four-colour stack of sieve trays in the corner is this station's real identity: 50/100/200/500 um fractions that replace sci-swir-01's modelled band-depth look-up table with a measured one.
